tei:div.tei:p: "u "!#༄༅ zab chos 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar nor bu'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so

brgyud pa phyi ma/ na mo gu ru dzā ha bī ra ka dag chos sku'i 'od klong nas lhun grub ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs rig rtsal sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku gang 'dul gdul bya'i re skong ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams la rang mdangs ngang du phyag 'tshal lo 'dir rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dzā ha bīr gyi zab chos 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdus nor bu'i do shal mthong ba rang grol ni de yang 'og min chos kyi dbyings chos sku'i zhing khams dmigs pas ma grub pa na 'khor 'das thams cad kyi spyi dpal gdod ma ye bzhugs kyi mgon po chos sku 'od mi 'gyur ba zhes bya ba de nyid kyis ka dag zang thal bzang ngan gyi dbye bsal dang bral ba thig le lnga ldan 'od lnga gcal du bkram pa lhun grub bde chen gyi zhing khams na longs spyod rdzogs sku thugs rje chen po mtshan dpe nges pa lnga ldan pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa de nyid la gsungs des shar phyogs ri po ta la zhes bya bar rigs gsum mgon po'i pho brang 'od zer gyi gur khang du sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul pa sku la skye 'chi dang bgres rgud mi mnga' ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma kun gyi g.yog byed pa dregs pa sde brgyad bran du khol ba de nyid la gsungs des rgya gar grub thob chen po ma hā nā tha zhes par sprul de nyid kyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr zhes pa 'pho med 'od lus 'grub pa de nyid la gnang de la slob ma grub pa thob pa'i skyes chen 'ja' lus zag med du grub pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod kyang yongs grags kyi bu chen brgyad ni 'di lta ste badz+ra nā tha bh+ra ma nā tha dhe wa nā tha shrī nā tha dzin+dha bhī ra ma ṇi kā nā tha paṇ+ḍi ta sau khya a mā ra su kha de rnams 'pho med 'od lus grub pa kho na'o da lta'ang las ldan rnams kyis zhal mngon sum du mjal ba dang*/

gsung gi gdams pa thob pa ni shin tu mang ngo khyad par rig gnas kun la mkhyen pa rgyas par mdzad pa badz+ra nā thas bla ma'i lung bstan dang gdul bya'i dus babs dang bstun bod yul du phebs nas sa skya ba dang karma pa gnyis la bka' babs yod pa'i lo rgyus phul pas sku sgrob dang sku 'gongs kyis sa kar gnyis la rten 'brel ma 'grig dus mi ring bar sa skya pa gdung gis phongs shing karma pa bstan pas phongs pa gcig yong ngam gsungs slar yang bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin du rdzu 'phrul gyis dbur stod 'bri khung du lha sras mu khri btsan po'i rnam sprul gter ston gnam lcags me 'bar ram sna tshogs rang grol rin chen phun tshogs zhes pa de nyid la yongs rdzogs gnang zhing bka' babs so skyes chen de nyid ni sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rang sangs rgyas bden par smra ba zhes bya bar skye ba bzhes de nas rim bzhin rgya gar grong khyer mthu srung zhes par yab badz+ra hūm̐ kār dang yum rat+na tā re zhes pa'i sras hūm̐ kā ra zhes par skye ba bzhes de nas rgya gar lho phyogs ra sa zhes par yab rgyal po ut+pal dang yum btsun mo mdzes ldan ma'i sras dge khyim zhes par skye ba bzhes de nas rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs yul 'od ldan gyi rgyal po siṃ ha rā dza dha ra dang btsun mo lak+ṣ+mī zhes pa'i sras bha dra pā la zhes par skye ba bzhes yang yul de nyid du yab shān+ta sa ra yum rasmi li ka zhes pa'i sras dharma pā la zhes par skye ba bzhes de nas bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yab rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan dang yum tshe spong bza'i sras mu tig btsan po'am khri sde srong btsan nam 'jing yon sad na legs sam mu khri btsan po zhes par skye ba bzhes de 'og bod khams su yab ston pa sangs rgyas zhes pa dang yum chos ldan zhes pa'i sras shes dpal zhes par skye ba bzhes de nas rdzogs chen rnal 'byor dri med 'od zer gyi sras sprul sku zla ba grags pa zhes bya bar skye ba bzhes

de nas 'bri khung gi sa phyogs su yab rin chen chos kyi rgyal po dang yum rin chen sgron ma gnyis kyi sras rin chen rnam rgyal zhes par skye ba bzhes de nas dbur stod 'bri khung dkon gnyer sgang zhes par yab chos kyi rgyal po bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang yum bsod nams sgron ma zhes pa'i sras su me mo sbrul gyi lo la sku bltams dgung lo brgyad kyi steng gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo grur spyan snga chos kyi grags pa'i drung du rab tu byung mtshan rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po zhes bya bar gsol dgung lo bcu gsum steng dkar po kun dga' grags pas khra 'brug gi zhig gsos mdzad pa'i rab gnas la gdan 'dren zhus gnas nges med du sgrub pa la bzhugs pas thugs rje chen po gsang ba mchog lam dang sgrol dkar yid bzhin nor mchog 'khor lo bdun ma'i gdams pa khyad par can dag snang du byung de nas dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa'i dus 'bri khung ti sgro na sgrub pa la bzhugs pa'i dus paṇ+ḍi ta chen po badz+ra nā tha dpon slob bcu gcig byon nas tshe gcig lus gcig la 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i gdams ngag dzā ha bīr rlung khrid phyi nang gsang gsum yongs rdzogs kyi bka' babs so ma hā gu ru'i zab yig lung bstan las e ma nga yi gdams ngag nyon mongs rang grol la gces par dgos pa'i rlung zas lag len ni lha sras skye ba brgyud de chos 'di dang 'phrad tshe nga dang mi gnyis dzā ha bīr rgya gar yul 'byung grub pa'i rig 'dzin brnyes de yi yang zab rlung gi gdams pa ni 'chi med grub pa'i gnad kun lon gyur te pad+ma nga yi thugs rjes 'phrad pas longs zhes dang de nyid rang la skyob pa'i dag snang lung bstan las slob dpon dang rdo rje bdud 'joms la 'brel ba thogs pa zhig gis khyod kyi chos skal bdag gis sprod par gyur cig ces pa'i smon lam btab pa de yang mi 'gyangs par bya bral gyi tshul bzung nas khyod dang 'phrad par 'dug pas the tshom med par longs shig

gsungs pa bzhin 'brug lo'i nang du paṇ+ḍi ta badz+ra nā tha dang mjal nas gdams ngag zab mo nyams bzhes gnang nas bzhugs tshe bkres pa'i rkyen gyis 'jigs pa mi snang na'ang skom pa la phan pa zhig dgos par 'dug snyam pa'i tshe zhag bdun song ba'i tshe bya rog gis 'phrul 'khor la brten nas rlung skom du 'thung ba'i gdams ngag byung bya rog de nyid ni badz+ra nā tha dang mgon po'i sprul pa'o de nyid kyi drung du rdzogs chen pa tshul khrims sangs rgyas zhes bya ba 'khrungs yul rtse gdong rus skyob pa sku gzhon nu la rab tu byung ngor pa dkon mchog lhun grub 'bri khung zur pa sogs bla ma mang du bsten gsar rnying gi chos mang po gsan zhing rtse gdong bdag chen gyis rdzogs chen par mtshan gsol rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr gyi gdams ngag kho na la brten nas zab bu gter lung bdun par mi lo chen po bdun gyi bar du dzā ha bīr gyi rlung zas kho na mdzad pas rlung zas kyis gegs grol nas rlung sems la rang dbang thob bkod pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul du mar sprul zhing yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams su phebs shing ye shes kyi mkhyen pa dang ldan pa de nyid la bka' babs so de nyid kyi drung du mnga' ris pa 'od gsal mchog ldan zhes 'khrungs yul gu ge sbi te rong chung gi lung pa rkos sbrang 'bud rgyal sa sbyin zhes pa der yab zhang blon dar ma phrin las zhes pa dang yum ni chos rgyal khri srong gi dus lo tsā ba cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan de'i bu sring mo cog ro bza' rgyal po'i btsun mor bzhes chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud mnga' ris su chad pa'i dus cog ro'i rgyud pa rnams sku'i gnas pa yin pa dang yon tan mkhas pas bdag rkyen mtho bar mdzad pas phyag phyir 'brangs te gu ge sbi ti rong chung dgon pa chags de nas mi rabs bcu gsum gyi bar du yang phur la grub pa thob pa mang du byung

de nas sngags grong du song ste dbang rgyun chad slar yang dbus gtsang du byon nas dbang lung khrid gsum mang du gsan nas yar log dgon pa gsar du btab nas 'gro don yang rgya cher byung ba'i sring mo dbon mo nyi ma bzang mo zhes pa'i sras su me mo sbrul la sku 'khrungs mtshan dkon mchog tshe ring du btags 'khrungs nas zhag bdun song ba'i tshe grub chen dzā ha bīr gyi slob ma dzin+dha bhī ra zhes pa dpon slob bdun mtsho ma pham mjal bar byon pa'i dus bu chung de nyid kyi dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i thig le byas te 'di skad gsungs byis pa 'di nyid dam chos ma dar ba'i sar skyes kyang chos ldan bod du chos dang 'phrad par 'gyur bcu gsum ma 'gyangs dbus gtsang yul du rdzongs snyigs dus sems can rnams kyi mgon skyabs byed gsungs so de nas dgung lo bcu bzhi lon tshe rang gi a khu rig 'dzin dpal 'bar zhes pa'i rgyab tu spyan drangs te glo bo stod smad kyi gnas gang yod mjal khyad par mu ku ched ta ra zhes pa'i chu mig brgya rtsar rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr dngos mjal dzā bīr gdams ngag yongs rdzogs gnang zhing zab bu lung du rang gi tshe rabs kyi bla ma yod pa'i lung bstan dang dbus gtsang na 'gro don dpag med yong gsungs pa ltar zab lung gter lung bdun par the tshom med par phebs pas rdzogs chen tshul khrims sangs rgyas dang mjal grub chen dzā ha bīr gyi gdams pa mtha' dag brtse bas rjes su bzung zhing rten 'brel ma lus par 'grig cing skyes chen dam pa mang po'i zhabs la gtugs rab 'byams rnam drug la gnas pa rab 'byams pa byams pa phun tshogs 'bum rab 'byams pa dpal 'byor shes rab jo gdan pa lung rig rgya mtsho gser mdog can gyi mkhan chen karma bzang po skyed tshal mkhan po ngag dbang grags pa 'phyong rgyas rab 'byams pa dgon gsar ba gter ston rnam gsum la gter ston zhig po gling pa gter ston bde chen gling pa

'phrang mgo gter ston shes rab 'od zer rdor 'dzin rnam pa drug la mus pa dpal ldan don grub brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang shar pa kun dga' bkra shis lha rje blo gros rgyal mtshan sna nam pa bde legs phun tshogs grwa thang bla chen po sde bla rnam gsum ni 'bri khung khri thog pa kun dga' rin chen sa skya khri thog pa kun dga' bsod nams 'brug pa khri thog pa mi pham chos rgyal lo sngags 'chang rnam drug ni mnga' ris rig 'dzin dpal 'bar byang bkra bzang ba pad+ma dbang chen e pa chos kyi rgyal po gtsang rong tshe bdag rdo rje 'bri khung zur pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal dge legs phun tshogs rnal 'byor gsum ni rdzogs chen rnal 'byor tshul khrims sangs rgyas phyag chen rnal 'byor bkra shis ston pa rtsa rlung rnal 'byor byams pa chos rin no bshes gnyen drug ni nub dgon pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan drug pa rtogs chung ba karma phun tshogs rnam rgyal sangs rgyas rdo rje brag rgan pa nam mkha' rdo rje 'di la dzā bīr zur bkol thams cad gsan pa yin gangs ri thod dkar ba'i sku skye dpa' bo sprul sku sogs bsten zhing de dag rnams kyis gdams ngag bum pa gang byo thams cad gnang khyad par rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā bīr lan gsum zhal gzigs shing gdams pa yongs rdzogs nye brgyud du gsan gzhan yang grub thob rnam bzhi zhal gzigs nas grub thob tshe sgrub thabs lam dmar khrid la sogs pa'i gdams pa khyad par can mang po dag snang du byung zhing dgung lo brgya dang lnga bcu nga bdun bzhugs de nyid kyi zhabs drung du bdag sogs rnams kyi 'dren mchog dam pa rig 'dzin chos rgyal rdo rje zhes snyan pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum du khyab pa de nyid bres phur lo tsā ba chen po gnyags dz+nyā na'i gdung rgyud du 'khrungs shing sku gzhon nu'i dus skyes chen dam pa'i rnam thar mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa tshang zhing gsang sngags gsar rnying bka' gter ring lugs thams cad la mkhyen pa rgyas shing

sgro 'dogs phyogs med du bcad dka' spyad snying rus kyi go cha rmad du byung bas sgrub pa rtse gcig gis rang don mngon du gyur cing grub pa brnyes pas gzhan don thugs bskyed kyi las 'phro'i 'bras bu bcud du smin pa dang 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i gnas lugs zang thal mngon du gyur pas dus gsum sa ler mkhyen pa pad+ma'i bka' lung zab mo las kyang dharma rā dza zhes bya ba gtsang shangs e dmar phyogs su 'byung rta mgrin byin rlabs skyes bu yin 'phrad tshad ngan song 'khor lo gcod ces dang dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgya ma las bsam yas nub byang mtshams kyi ri nag rtsar dharma'i ming can chos rgyal gsung sprul ni zhang rigs spyod pa rlabs chen 'gro ba 'dul zhes dang rdor sems lung bstan snying gi mun sel las de dang dus mtshungs myang smad nyi lung du chos rgyal gsung sprul kun dga'i ming can gcig sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dngos grub brnyes pa 'byung kun dga'i ming can zhes pa ni rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid sku chung ngu'i dus su yab yum rnams kyis gces ming kun dga' bstan 'dzin du btags pas na kun dga' zhes pa'o ces pa'i mtshungs bral chen po de nyid la dzā bīr yongs rdzogs kyi bka' babs so de nyid kyis rgyal khams sprang po nyi zla klong gsal la gnang ba'o zhes rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dzā ha bīr gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdus nor bu'i do shal 'di nyid snyigs dus kyi sprang po nyi zla klong gsal gyis bgyis pa'o drang srong gza' brgyad bka' yi bya ra mdzod ྈྈ 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las lo rgyus nyi zla zung 'brel bzhugs so oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dzā ha bīr sid+dhi ye nas ka dag mi dmigs spros bral klong lhun grub ma 'gags rang gsal mtshan 'dzin bral zung 'jug kun khyab mtha' bral thugs rje 'bar rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā bīr zhabs la 'dud 'ja' lus mchog stsol 'od phung rang grol gyi

lo rgyus phyi nang gsang gsum bkod pa la chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gnang du gsol de la 'dir snyigs dus kyi sprang po nyi zla klong gsal kho bo chung byis pa a li ma'i dus su rmi lam nyams snang thams cad la bud med mang po 'tshogs nas rang gi sdod rogs dang rtse grogs byed cing nub mo yang rang nyal tshe mal gyi mtha' bskor nas bag dro hur re sdod pa dang yang skabs 'ga' rer mkha' 'gro ma su kha sid+dhi yin zer ba'i bud med dkar mo rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa gcig yang yang byung nas su kha chos drug yin zer ba'i po ti shin tu legs pa gcig bstan nas 'di nyams su blangs na don chen 'grub zer ba dang rtsa rlung 'phrul 'khor gyi gling bzhi 'degs pa gling bzhi bgrad pa gling bzhi dgram pa gling bzhi sdud pa gzer them bkag pa la sogs bstan zhing mkha' 'gro ma de lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa kho na byung yang skabs gcig tsa na gong gi mkha' 'gro ma de bud med mi sdug pa'i cha byad du sprul nas phyag g.yas kyi gri gug gis rang lus gshags nas rtsa ro rkyang dbu gsum 'khor lo lnga grangs can grangs med kyi rtsa 'khor rnams mngon sum du bstan nas khyod kyis 'di lta bu bsgom na 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob gsungs pa zhig kyang byung de nas rang lo bcu 'gro tshe nam mkha' nas shog dril zheng sor bzhi tsam la dkyus mtho do byas pa la yi ge gzab chung brtsegs ma'i gzhug tu mchan bus kyang shin tu mdzes par byas pa gcig lag tu byung de slar yi ge shes tshe bstas pas rgya gar grub thob dzā bīr zhes pa'i gdams pa rlung zas su za tshul skom du 'thung tshul rlung rta ru zhon pa gos su gyon pa dwangs ma dkar dmar spel sbyong bgyis te zag med 'od lus sgrub thabs de rnams kyi gegs sel bogs 'don sogs 'dug kyang don ni ma go dga' tshor dpag med byung nas rang gar sdod kyi sngas mgor bzhag pas

rjes su shog dril de bskyur nas ma byung bas snying don pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal byung nas mnga' ris stod phyogs la ni dzā bīr zhes pa'i sgra yang mi grags pa 'dug de nga rgyal khams gang na yod kyang zhu dgos snyams te pha ma gnyen tshan nor rdzas tshe 'di'i ltar snang thams cad blos rgyang btang te grwa sa chen po gser mdog can du slob gnyer la yong yang mdo phyogs la sems ma song zhing rdzogs pa chen po 'di rang gi pha chos yin pas zhu ba la snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan rig 'dzin chen po chos rgyal rdo rje'i sku zhabs su rdzogs chen bka' gter bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang lung khrid gsum bcud len skor mang po dang khyad par du rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā bīr gyi skor yongs rdzogs brtse bas rjes su bzung zhing 'di skad gsungs kho bo la dang po mnga' ris 'od gsal mchog ldan gyis dzā bīr gyi gdams pa bum pa gang byor gnang zhing chos bdag tu lung bstan bkra shis mnga' gsol mdzad de rgyal tshab tu bkod pa yin cing de bzhin du dge slong rang yang yang tig nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā bīr gyi gdams pa zab mo phung po 'od lus su 'grub pa 'di nyid kyi chos bdag yin pas de ring man chad khyed kyi ming la dge slong dzā bīr 'ja' lus snang stong rang grol gyis shig gsungs dzā bīr nye brgyud dang bcas pa gnang dbugs dbyung gzeng bstod 'gro don byed pa'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol gnang bas kho bos kyang bla ma'i bka' bzhin gdams ngag chud ma zos shing rnam g.yeng le lor ma shor bar nges med kyi ri khrod rnams su tshe 'di blos btang ste mi lo drug bdun tsam mi zas rags pa spangs nas dka' thub bcud len gyi rigs mang po dang skabs skabs su sbang rtsam thur mgo re la brten nas sgom pa'i tshe bud med dkar mo rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zhig yang yang byung nas

rang lus gzhan lus kyi nyams len 'phrul 'khor gyi gnad dang bde ba'i bogs 'don shes rab gsang ba'i bcud kyis yang yang tshims par byas nas 'di skad gsungs pad+ma ri dwags dung sna can glang chen lcugs phran la sogs pa'i rigs lnga'i mtshan rtags shes rab ma las rgyar bsten na thar lam bgrod nga rgyal sdom pas ma bcings par bde stong dga' bzhi'i rang zhal ltos snod bcud lha yi rol par khyer phyi nang 'od gsal klong du grol zhes gsungs yang skabs gcig chu bar phu'i khru dkar khru nag zhes par gnas 'brel la sdod tshe yang gong gi mkha' 'gro ma des 'di skad gsungs kye ho 'ja' lus snang stong ras pa khyod gos dkar ral pa'i thor tshug sngags chas gyis nges med ri khrod rgyu zhing yid 'ong pad+mar rol gsang sngags dam tshig lnga ldan rtag tu gces sngar ming zhog la stong gsum dpal 'bar ram yang na gling bzhi dpal 'bar 'gro ba'i mgon rnam g.yeng spongs la brtul zhugs ldan pa yi bde stong bogs 'don las kyi phyag rgya ma pad+ma o rgyan chog pa'i ming 'dzom dang mdangs gsal bud med lnga'i shes rab gsang ba'i bcud thob cing bzang ming sgrub phug rnyed gyur na 'ja' lus 'grub par the tshom med zer ba sogs mang du byung yang zur du shes de nas yang ber chung dben pa'i ri khrod du mtshams dam po la yod tshe rang gi gcung po tshe ring chos 'phel zhes pa shi nas lo mang du song ba kho yin rgyu ba byas yong nas jo jo la a lce ni rgyab thur mdun thur thur ma'i lag len ston shog zer bas yongs pa yin zer nas rgyab thur mdun thur gyi 'dzug lugs khrag byung na 'dzag gcod bsdom pa rjes spyod byug bdug spyod lam byed tshul sogs bslab byung der bdag gis a lce'i ming la gang zer khyod rang sngar nas da bar gang du bsdad byas pas a lce'i ming la mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gtso mo dz+nyā na ḍā ki su kha sid+dhi zer nga rang sngar phan chad a lce'i logs su bsdad

da ni myur du jo jo rang gi phrin las sgrub pa'i bu mo gcig tu skye ba blangs te myur du mjal rgyu yin zer skye ba len tshul ming dang sa cha sogs bshad byung yang brjed nas ma byung de nas rgyun par dzā bīr gyi gdams pa kho na nyams len byas nas ber chung dben pa'i ri khrod du lto gos thams cad blos btang ste mdor na 'gro 'dug spyod lam yang ma byas par nyin mtshan med par nyams len gyi ngang la bsdad yod pa'i tshe rang gi mdun der rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr de nyid sku mdog dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa phyag g.yas seng lding gi ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing g.yon 'chi med tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa phrag pa g.yas g.yon du nyi zla dang mchan khung g.yas g.yon du me tog dkar dmar gyi phreng bas mdzes pa dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs la ral chings me tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dar dmar gyi ang rag gsol ba zhabs rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i steng na bzhugs te 'di skad gsungs pa'i nyams shig shar byung na mo gu ru sid+dhi bha wan+tu/ zab mo nges pa don gyi man ngag gis skal ldan tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la zhen log dad brtson lhag bsam sngon 'gro bas lhun grub rnam gsum nyams len srog shing mchog lam gyi rtsa ba byang sems mos gus te nyams rtogs rtsa ba rtsa rlung thig le yin dbu ma 'ja' lus gsal stong 'dzin med sgoms zag bcas 'khor ba'i rkyen la ma ltos par zag med rlung gis bza' btung gos rgyan 'tsho tshe yi mi mthun 'gal rkyen kun 'joms shing tsha grang bad mkhris nad rnams bshal skyug 'byin mthun rkyen nyams rtogs nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rgyas zla ba'i nyams len 'dod chags bdag pos brten sbubs 'dren gtsug tor bsgrub cing rlung gnyis bsre gegs sel yon tan skyed pa'i thabs la 'bad rgan po'i skyon bral tshe ring bkrag mdangs ldan cir snang dag pa'i snang ba 'khor yug la

gzung 'dzin re dogs bral ba'i myang 'das dngos tshe 'dir 'ja' lus mchog gi dngos grub thob ma ṇi dpal 'bar gzhan don lhun gyis grub tshogs gnyis dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo zhes dang kye ho dad ldan tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob 'dod rnams tshe sgrub zab mos rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bde drod gtum mos bag chags gnyis 'dzin bsreg 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma ye shes zas bcud 'tshol rkang mgyogs rlung gis mkha' spyod dngos grub bsgrub chu rlung zab mos skom pa'i tsha gdung sel btung ba'i bye brag phyi nang bcud sdud bya rtsa ba'i rlung lngas phyi nang bar chad sel rlung 'tsho bcud 'tshos bkrag mdangs gzi brjid bskyed khams la dbang thob 'pho med 'od lus 'grub ces gsung zhing gong ma de nyid gzhung sngar 'chad pa yin yang pus mo g.yas rdeb g.yon rdeb nyi zla'i 'dren 'grem rkang mgyogs pus nad sel ba sogs kyi 'phrul 'khor thams cad 'chug 'dug pas 'di bzhin gyis shig gsungs nas rlung 'dzin 'phrul 'khor sogs kyi bca' thabs mang du bstan nas 'ja' ltar yal songade lta bu'i gdams pa zab mo'i nyams len byed tshe zhag grangs bcu gsum gyi bar du dngos nyams rmi lam thams cad du grub pa'i dbang phyug dzā ha bīr dang 'bral med byung zhinganyin re me dbang tshar re byin 'beb bkra shis tshar re gnang zhing gdams pa mtha' dag thob pa'i nyams snang yang byung rung 'di dag ni rags bsdus phran bu yin zhing nyams su len pa'i chos byed pho mo thams cad la zab chos 'di'i byin rlabs thugs rje ngo mtshar rtags gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'byung zhing 'gro ba kun la'ang phan bde rgya chen po gcig yong bsam pas las ldan bdag gi rjes su zhugs pa rnams kyis sems la zhog ces rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr gyi gdams pa ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus 'di nyid shud pu dpal seng gi gdung phreng las byon pa zhabs drung nyi zla rdo rjes bskul ngor
'ja' lus snang stong rang grol gyis brjed thor bris pa'o

ྈྈ 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las sngon 'gro byin rlabs thugs rje'i 'od 'bar bzhugs so na mo gu ru dzā ha bī ra bla ma mchog dang yi dam lha mkha' 'gro chos skyong dbyer med pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug dzā ha bīr gyi gdams pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la gsum sta skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i sgo nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom lus gnad mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas maṇ+ḍal dbang bzhi len pa'o dang po skyabs 'gro ni bdag sogs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi'o chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum la skyabs su mchi'o bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi'o rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum la skyabs su mchi'o rang sems stong gsal chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o smon pa sems bskyed ni sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya de'i phyir du bdag gis 'ja' lus chos sku sgrub pa'i lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o don dam sems bskyed ni na mo bdag gis sems can kun don du 'di bzung 'khor ba dong nas ma sprugs bar tshad med bzhi ldan lhag bsam rmang bting nas sku gsum gtan srid zin par sems bskyed do gsum mam bdun brjod rdor sems sgom bzlas ni hūm̐ rang lus tha mal spyi gtsug nyi zla'i steng bla ma rdor sems rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: zhi tshul rgyan ldan thugs srog bdud rtsi'i chu tshangs bug nas zhugs nyams chag dag gyur cig yig brgya brgya stong khri 'bum bzlas brjod bya bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ phyi nang chos kun stong gsal 'dzin med ngang

rang nyid dpral bar 'ja' tshon 'od lnga'i klong rtsa ba'i bla ma grub chen dzā ha bīr rab byung dzo ki rdo rje'i 'dug stangs can sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dpag med 'phros rgyal ba rab 'byams byin rlabs ma lus kun tshur 'dus yongs gyur bla ma'i gnas lngar thim bla ma 'od phung 'ja' zer bde drod 'bar 'ja' lus 'od skur grol ba'i dngos grub stsol de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni oṃ āḥhūm̐ kun bzang snang mtha' byams mgon spyan ras gzigs rig 'dzin pad+ma ma hā nā tha la rtse gcig mi 'bral snying nas gsol ba 'debs rtsa mdud rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs 'byung lnga'i rlung zas mthar phyin 'byongs pa dang zag med 'od lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs dzā ha bīr dang badz+ra nā tha dang gter ston gnam lcags rdzogs chen tshul khrims mtshan rtse gcig mi 'bral snying nas gsol ba 'debs rtsa mdud rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs 'byung lnga'i rlung zas mthar phyin 'byongs pa dang zag med 'od lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs 'od gsal mchog ldan chos rgyal rdo rje dang rtsa ba'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la rtse gcig mi 'bral snying nas gsol ba 'debs rtsa mdud rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs 'byung lnga'i rlung zas mthar phyin 'byongs pa dang zag med 'od lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs bka' srung gza' brgyad zab mo rlung khrid dang gnas yul skyong ba'i chos srung dam can la rtse gcig mi 'bral snying nas gsol ba 'debs rtsa mdud rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs 'byung lnga'i rlung zas mthar phyin 'byongs pa dang zag med 'od lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol btab mthus stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis rtsa mdud rnams ma lus grol nas 'pho med mchog gi sku 'gyur ba med pa tshe 'dir thob par shog de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni oṃ āḥhūm̐ sgyu lus snang stong rtsa 'khor bdun ldan nang

dwangs ma ye shes dkar dmar 'od skur 'khyil dga' bzhi mnyam sbyor bde chen maṇ+ḍal 'di sku gsum bla ma brgyud par bcas la 'bul rtsa rlung bde drod 'bar ba'i dngos grub stsol gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza hūm̐ dbang bzhi zhu ba ni oṃ āḥhūm̐ he ru ka dpal khyab bdag srid zhi'i mgon mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gzi byin mchog bdag sogs lus ngag yid la smin grol stsol bum dbang gsang dbang shes rab ye shes dbang bzhi pa'i dbang bskur sa lam mthar phyin nas zung 'jug kun khyab bde chen mchog thob shog kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ de nas smon lam btab pa ni ho bdag gzhan ma gyur 'gro ba rnams rnyed dka'i dal 'byor gces mthong zhing mi rtag 'chi ba'i skyo shas kyis 'khor ba'i gnas tshul 'jigs mthong zhing 'gro kun pha mar gces 'dzin zhing snang ba snying rje'i rnam pa dang stong nyid snying rje'i srog 'dzin cing zab lam rgyud sde bzhi yi don tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam bskyed rdzogs gnad kun rab rtogs nas rtsa rlung thig le las rung zhing 'jigs med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'pho med mngon du 'gyur bar shog bkra shis ni oṃ āḥhūm̐ sku yi bkra shis mi shigs rdo rje'i sku gsung gi bkra shis 'gag med tshangs pa'i gsung thugs kyi bkra shis rig stong 'khrul pa bral yon tan bkra shis bde stong lhun gyis grub phrin las bkra shis kun khyab thugs rje'i rtsal skye 'chi gnyis bral 'pho med bde ba che 'ja' lus 'od skur 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog ces 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol gyi sngon 'gro byin rlabs thugs rje 'od 'bar zhes bya ba 'ja' lus snang stong rang grol gyis bgyis pa'o drang srong chen po gza' brgyad kyis srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa rā hu la hūm̐ ྈྈ 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las dbang mchog bde chen bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bzhugs sa ོ na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā kī nī dzā ha bīr sid+dhi bha wan+tu

grub pa'i dbang phyug dzā bīr 'khor mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo 'dir dad ldan slob ma tshe 'di blos btang zhing phyi ma don du gnyer ba'i skal ldan rnams la gtum mo'i me dbang nyon mongs bag chags sreg byed bde chen bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi lag len ni dus sbyor tshes grangs bzang po la gnas khang phyag dar rkyang nul bya stegs bu mda' gang gru bzhi'i steng chang dang sin+dhu ra yis byugs dkyil 'khor pho brang pad 'dab brgyad sgo dang rta babs mu khyud bcas lte ba chos 'byung nyis brtsegs nang pad+ma 'dab bzhi phyogs tshon bya de dbus nyi zla khri 'u khar bum pa mgul chings kha rgyan dang shel dang me long tsaka li bsham g.yon du bhan+dha mtshan ldan nang byang sems dkar dmar gsang rdzas sbyar me long dkyil 'khor kha gcod can dar dmar lding gur phub pa bsham g.yas su gtor ma 'bar ba la g.yung drung ris kyis brgyan pa bsham rgyab tu dpal 'bar mda' gang tshad dkar ser dmar ljang mthing lnga bsham mdun du ting lo phyag len bzhin me ri gsum gsum dag dang bcas de dbus chas dbang rdzas kun dang slob ma du yod thams cad kyi ras dkar sgom thag ang rag la bsang sbyang khrus dang bgegs bskrad la yig 'bru gsum dang raṃ bris nas ye shes me dpung 'bar bar bsam gzhan yang phyi nang gsang mchod dang sman raka gtor ma rgyas par bsham las bum 'byung lnga'i lha mor bskyed de nas bla mas sgom bzlas ni rdo rje phag mo'i las gzhung bsrang dbang rdzas byin rlabs ldan par bskyed lhag ma yan chad grub nas kyang de nas slob ma rnams la gong gi ras dkar ang rag sgom thag byin rlabs dang ldan pa de bkon te slob ma du yod khrus nas phyung dkyil 'khor bskor zhing 'dzab mang bzla yol ba'i phyi ru 'khod byas nas langs te brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang maṇ+ḍal phyag mchod drag tu bya de nas bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad cing srung 'khor bsgoms nas gral la 'khod

dpa' bo g.yas la dpa' mo g.yon gdan du g.yung drung raṃ mtshan bting bla mas chos kyi lo rgyus dang chos bshad skyabs sems yan lag bdun sngon 'gro'i nang bzhin bgyis nas kyang 'bud pa dgu phrugs yang yang bya phyi nang sdig sgrib phyir dor nas me shel lta bur gsal btab la zhu 'bul gsol ba 'di ltar btab rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs bdag cag nyon mongs 'khor ba las bsgral phyir ye shes dkyil 'khor du bde stong zag pa med pa yi dbang mchog dam pa bstsal du gsol smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol ye shes bde drod sbar du gsol zhes lan gsum zhus pa'i lan du bla mas 'di ltar bsgo bar bya e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu dkyil 'khor dam pa'i sgor zhugs nas smin cing grol bar 'dod pa na bla ma'i bsgo ba nyan pa dang dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung nus na ji ltar 'dod pa sbyin par bya zhes pa'i lan du kye ho bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yis ji ltar bsgo ba'i gsung nyan cing dam tshig dag las mi 'da' bsrung thugs rje brtse bas gzung du gsol zhes zhus nas slob ma'i lag tu rdo rje gtad lce thog tu bdud rtsi myang du bcug la hūm̐ hrī nga ni dbang chen he ru ka khyed la dam tshig sbyin par bya rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig rnams nyams pa med par rtag tu srungs gal te nyams na dmyal bar ltung ma nyams byin rlabs dngos grub thob khyod kyis ji ltar 'dod pa'i don thams cad ma lus myur du 'grub sa ma ya u da ka ṭha ṭha na ra kan zhes dam tshig gi rnam dbye rgyas par bshad de nas slob ma rnams la phag mo'i bskyed rim phog rdo rje skyil krung lag pa gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ngag gnad rlung bzung smra ba bskyung yid gnad ma yengs dmigs pa ni spyi bor haṃ yig dkar po gyen du bzhengs pa rtsa gsum 'dus mtshams su a thung gsal btab snying khar dga' ba 'khyil pa dmar po g.yon du 'khor bar bsam bshang sgor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yos

a thung las me 'bar zhing spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs dga' ba 'khyil ba la phog pas rgyud bskul te rang dbang med par drag tu 'khor ba las 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa lta bur byon par bsam la ye shes dbab pa'i rdzas bsregs te dpon slob thams cad dmigs pa brtan pos rol mo sna tshogs sbir te byin 'beb spyan 'dren ni hūm̐ hrī chos dbyings bde chen dpal ri 'od gsal klong dag pa rab 'byams mkha' 'gro'i 'ja' sprin 'khrigs rang byung lhun grub pad 'byung yab yum dang zhi khro rab 'byams rtsa gsum dwangs ma'i lha 'dir byon skal ldan bu la byin gyis rlobs hūm̐ hrī o rgyan dur khrod pho brang chen po nas chos dbyings ngang las khro mo'i skur sprul ma rdo rje phag mo dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig 'dir byon skal ldan bu la byin gyis rlobs shar phyogs mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gnas mchog nas dkar mo zhi mdzad zhi ba'i skur sprul ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig 'dir byon skal ldan bu la byin gyis rlobs lho phyogs dpal ldan rin chen gnas mchog nas ser mo rgyas mdzad rgyas pa'i skur sprul ma rin chen mkha' 'gro dbyings nas skur= 'dir byon skal ldan= nub phyogs dbang sdud pad+ma'i gnas mchog nas dmar mo dbang mdzad dbang gi skur sprul ma pad+ma mkha' 'gro dbyings nas skur= 'dir byon skal ldan= byang phyogs tshar gcod las kyi gnas mchog nas ljang mo las mdzad phrin las skur sprul ma las kyi mkha' 'gro dbyings nas skur= 'dir byon skal ldan= dam tshig mkha' 'gro sna tshogs mkha' 'gro dang sha za mkha' 'gro 'jig rten mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro sde lnga srung ma las byed rnams thugs rjes myur mgyogs glog ltar 'khyug cing byon thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'ja' 'od thibs se thib

ye shes rnam lnga'i 'od zer ta la la bde stong zag med 'ja' 'od khyil li li 'pho med 'ja' lus 'od phung phungs se phung dga' bzhi 'dzag bral bde stong khri li li rang lus snang stong lha skur spungs se spung bde drod ye shes me dpung lhabs se lhab dwangs ma ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol ye shes rnam lnga'i me dpung sbar du gsol rang byung gtum mo'i bde drod sbar du gsol 'ja' lus 'od gsal klong du grol ba dang zung 'jug kun khyab bde chen mchog thob shog oṃ sarba ma hā gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dz+nyā na dz+wa la raṃ raṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā e ā ral+li hriṃ hriṃ pheṃ pheṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho zhes drag tu brjod cing me tog 'thor phebs rtags spyi dang mthun brtan byed rdo rje rgya gram spyi bor bzhag la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis zung 'jug tu bstim 'bru gsum brjod de nas so sor bstims pas lha'i sku gsung thugs su gyur par bsam de nas dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la maṇ+ḍal phul te dbang don gsol ba btab pa ni hūm̐ hrī bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la bdag sogs gus pas gsol ba 'debs dbang bskur byin rlabs bstsal du gsol smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab bum dbang bskur ba ni hūm̐ hrī chos sku longs sku sprul pa'i sku bla ma sku gsum bde ba che rigs kyi bu la byin gyis rlobs byin rlabs bde stong dbang bskur stsol oṃ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥtsan+dha lī shwa ra sarba ta thā ga te shwa ra raṃ swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ a bhi ṣiñca ā+oṃ ces pas gnas lngar dbang bskur bum chus khrus 'thung byed du bcug de nas thod pa me long mar me gnas gsum du bzhag la hūm̐ hrī byin rlabs mkha' 'gro bde ster ma ye shes dbyings kyi rang bzhin mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur bas bde drod phrin las dbang thob shog oṃ sarba ma hā gu ru badz+ra de wa ḍā ki nī dz+nyā na dz+wa la raṃ raṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā

wā ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ de nas slob ma rnams la rtsa 'khor lnga grangs can grangs med kyi rtsa dang rlung thig le'i gnas tshul bshad cing de rnams su bla ma yab yum gyi byang sems kyis gang bar bsam ste 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa phog la bla mas bdud rtsi byang sems gsang rdzas kyi bhan+dha kha phyes te slob ma rnams kyi khar byin zhing gnas lngar thig le byas la 'di skad do hūm̐ hrī lus la rtsa rlung thig le byang sems gnas de dag ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bzhugs gnas te ngo bo sangs rgyas rnams kyi rang bzhin can gzhan du bsgom bya sgom byed ci la yod dbu ma snying po'i rtsa ru byang sems gnas pa'i phyir rtsa rlung thig le drod kyi dbang bskur ro bum dbang gi sngags brjod dbang bskur la ho skal ldan khyod la rtsa rlung thig le drod kyi dbang bskur pas bde drod rtogs pa rgyud la skyes nas bcom ldan rta phag yab yum gyi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par gyur cig ces brjod rdor dril snying khar bzhag la hūm̐ hrī bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas byin rlabs bde drod rang 'bar zhing blo 'das mtha' bral rtogs par shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥtrāṃ hrīḥ.ā a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ lag par yang sbyin mar me lag mthil gnyis dang spyi bor bzhag la hūm̐ hrī nyon mongs tshang tshing bud shing sreg ye shes gsal ba'i sgron me mchog skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas chags bral bde drod 'bar bar shog ā+oṃ karma mā le ma hā su kha ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñca ho de nas dpal 'bar gyi dbang bskur ba ni hūm̐ hrī dpal 'bar me dpung 'ja' 'od gzhal yas su bla ma rtsa gsum 'od phung 'ja' zer 'khrigs ma sring mkha' 'gro grangs med rnam mang 'tshogs ye shes 'od lnga'i me dpung lhabs se lhab bag chags gnyis 'dzin bud shing bsregs gyur nas gzhon nu bum skur 'pho med 'jigs bral shog 'dzab brjod dbang don ngo sprod bya

ras dbang bskur ba ni hūm̐ hrī gzung 'dzin gos spangs ras dkar dri med dang bde stong zung 'jug thabs shes sgom thag dang mkha' 'gro dbang sdud dar dmar ang rag dang mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i dur khrod chas dbang gis skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur pas snang ba dbang sdud mkha' spyod myur bgrod shog 'dzab gong bzhin brjod do de nas gtor dbang bskur ba ni hūm̐ hrī zhi rgyas dbang drag thogs med rgyal phrin las yongs rdzogs bkra shis 'bar skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas 'bar 'dzag bde drod mthar phyin zhing bar chad bdud las rgyal bar shog gong gi 'dzab dang bcas pas gnas gsum du bskur de lta bu'i dbang zab mo yang gsang rmad du byung ba thob nas dam tshig bsrung ba gal che dam tshig rgyas par gzhan du shes bsdu na 'di ltar bsrung bar gces rgyud las bla mas ci gsung rgyal ba'i bka' rgyal ba'i bka' las 'da' mi byed khri drug rdo rje dmyal bar skye de mthar dmyal ba sham bha la sdug bsngal bshad kyis mi lang myong dam tshig nyams pa'i gson pa bas dam tshig gtsang mar shi ba rung btsun pa 'dul khrims med pa dang sngags pa dam tshig med pa dang bud med ngo tsha med pa gsum gang la mi gtogs mi srid do de bas 'bad pa du ma yis nyon mongs rnam par 'joms pa dang mi dge spong la brtson par gyis dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dag la rmi lam ngan pa thams cad rmi mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad 'byung ltas ngan thams cad 'byung ba yin lo skeg zla skeg zhag gi skeg dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur gshin rje'i zhags pa thams cad gdengs gdon bgegs che dgu thams cad gnod bkra mi shis pa thams cad 'byung rnam par g.yeng ba thams cad 'du rims kyi nad rigs thams cad 'go klu dang sa bdag gnyan rnams gnod rgyal po chom rkun me chu dug 'jigs pa bcu drug tshe 'dir 'byung gzhan las dam nyams slob mar min dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dag dang yul lung gcig tu mi sdod cing

chu klung gcig la mi 'thung ngo zhes dang gzhan du dam tshig nyams pa dang rang gi dam tshig nyams pa la spyir gsang sngags dam tshig gi chos 'brel sogs ma 'brel bar byed dgos te bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang po'i zhal nas bla mar smad pa'i gang zag ni rmi lam du yang mthong mi bya zhes dang pha ma gnyis bsad dgra bcom lnga brgya bkrongs de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'bum brgya phrag bshigs de las bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la log lta skad cig tsam la skyes gyur na rnam smin brgya phrag gnyis kyis che bar 'gyur zhes dang nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems dang gsang sngags dam tshig ma nyams bsrung khyad par dam tshig sku gsung thugs srog la babs kyang bsrung bar bya zhes gsungs pa ltar sku gsung thugs sogs kyi dam tshig ma nyams par bya'o dam tshig srung ba'i phan yon ni gnas skabs su lus kyi nad gdon zhi gzi brjid phun sum tshogs mthar thug 'ja' lus zag med rdo rje'i skur grol bar 'gyur te dri med pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi rgyud las dam tshig theg chen chos kyi srog ma nyams srung ba'i rnal 'byor la ye shes pho rgyud sprin ltar 'thibs ma dang mkha' 'gro bran bzhin 'breng dam can srung ma bran ltar khol mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'du zhes gsungs pas dam tshig spang blang shes shing bsrung ba gal che'o mtshan brjod las dam tshig chen po de nyid mkhyen dbang po bsam pa mkhyen mchog gis zhes gsungs pa ltar ro de nas dga' ston dang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul dbang 'di shin tu gnyan pas tshul dang ldan zhing dka' spyad snying rus la brtson pa bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba ci gsung dang du len pa la ster ba'i dus gser gyi maṇ+ḍal med pa dang tshogs 'khor med pa la ster du mi rung ngo gsum lnga bdun las spel mi rung de yi dam las 'gal gyur na drang srong gza' brgyad 'khor bcas kyis snying khrag zhal du bzhes shig rol bla ma'i rgya mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi rgya
drang srong gza' brgyad 'khor bcas kyi rgya yod do rā hu la rak+ṣa si

ྈྈ 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las dmar khrid sangs rgyas lag 'chang snying gi thig le bzhugs so na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sarba sid+dhi bha wan+tu zab mo nges pa don gyi man ngag gis skal ldan tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba'i chos zhen log dad brtson lhag bsam sngon 'gro bas zhes pas 'dir tshe gcig lus gcig la 'ja' lus chos sku sgrub pa'i myur lam zab mo'i gdams pa 'di nyid bla ma mkha' 'gros dngos su zhu dag dang bcas te mtshan rgya gar gyi skad du bgyis nas las dang skal bar ldan pa'i gang zag rnams la zab mo nges don snying po lam gyi mchog tu gyur pa sangs rgyas lag bcang gi gdams pa gsungs pa'i don la gsum ste sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum mo dang po sngon du 'gro ba la yang gsum ste thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dang khyad par gyi thun mong ngo de la dang po thun mong ni lam 'di nyid nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub par byed pa la bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa sngags srung gi man ngag rnam bzhi dang dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rigs drug gi sdug bsngal bsam pa ni spyi dang mthun no gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la khyad chos bzhi ste 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag skyon du shes te 'jig rten gyi phun sum tshogs pa la zhen pa log pa'i khyad chos thar pa'i bde ba mtha' dag yon tan du shes te de nyid la bsgrub 'dod kyi mos gus dang dad pa bskyed pa'i khyad chos thar pa'i bde ba bsgrub pa'i tshe rnam g.yeng le lo spangs te brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i khyad chos brtson 'grus des gtan gyi thar pa'i lam nyams su len pa'i tshe rang 'dod kyi yid kyi blo spangs te ci byed gzhan don du sems bskyed pa'i lhag bsam dang ldan pa'i khyad chos so gsum pa khyad par gyi thun mong ni 'ja' lus rdo rje'i tshig rkang las

lam gyi rtsa ba byang sems mos gus te zhes pas dga' dang snying rje byams pa dang btang snyoms bzhi ste snying rje tshad med pa rgyal po'i bu stor ba'am rnga mong gi phru gu stor ba'am lag rdum chus khyer ba ltar tshad med pa'i snying rje 'gro la gdung sems bsgom pa'o dga' ba tshad med pa rabs chad la bu skyes pa'am stor ba rnyed pa shi ba sos pa lta bu'i kun la dga' zhing mgu bar bya byams pa tshad med pa bya mo sgo ngar sred pa'am lug gi rdzi bo dang sman pa lta bur gzhan la phan pa'i 'du shes 'ba' zhig bsgom pa'o btang snyoms tshad med rgyal pos sbyin pa gtong ba'am drang srong gis gtor ma bsngo ba bzhin du phyogs ris dang bral ba'i kun khyab chen por bsgom pa'o mos gus zhes pa bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba'i mos gus ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin pa'i mos gus gang gsung dang du len pa'i mos gus ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus ci yod bla mar 'bul ba'i mos gus bla ma dang chos mig ltar du 'tsho zhing snying ltar du gces par 'dzin pa'i mos gus so de lta bu'i byang sems mos gus ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba gal po che yin pas gnad du bsnun pa gal shin tu che'o de rnams ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o dngos gzhi la gsum ste sems nyid kyi gzhi rtsa legs par gcod pa'i sgo nas lhun grub rnam gsum nyams su len pa dang kha zas kyi 'khri ba bcad cing 'byung lnga'i rlung zas su za ba dang gos kyi 'khri ba gcod cing bde stong gtum mo gos su gyon pa dang gsum mo dngos gzhi'i dang po 'ja' lus rdo rje'i tshig rkang las lhun grub rnam gsum nyams len srog shing mchog ces pa'i lhun grub rnam gsum ni gzhi nas ma bcos lhun grub kyi gnas lugs bzo med khyab gdal du go zhing de nyid kyi don la sems 'das ma 'das da lta dus gsum gyi rtog pa gang gis kyang ma yengs par mnyam par 'jog shes pa sangs rgyas myur du 'grub pa gzhi'i man ngag go

lam ma 'khrul lhun grub gnas lugs bzo med rang shar rang grol du go zhing de nyid kyi don la 'khrul med rtsal sbyong bogs 'don zhes pa sangs rgyas myur du 'grub pa'i lam gyi man ngag go 'bras bu ma bsgrub lhun grub kyi gnas lugs bzo med la yid ches brtan pa thob pa 'bras bu myang 'das su go zhing de nyid kyi don la gzung 'dzin re dogs dang bral ba thag chod kyi nyams len shes pa 'bras bu myur du sangs rgyas 'grub pa 'bras bu'i man ngag go de lta bu'i man ngag gi gnad go zhing mthar phyin du bskyangs pas 'khrul pa'i rdzun phugs rdib nas gnas lugs ka dag gi la bzla ba ni chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin srog gi mchog tu gyur pa yin no gnyis pa ni 'ja' lus rdo rje'i tshig rkang las zag bcas 'khor ba'i rkyen la ma ltos par zag med rlung lnga'i dwangs ma bcud du za zhes pas kha zas kyi 'khri ba gcod cing 'ja' lus su bgrod pa'i nyams len la gsum ste steng rlung zas su za ba dang 'og rlung zas su za ba dang bar rlung zas su za ba dang gsum las 'og rlung dang bar rlung za ba'i rim pa 'og tu bstan zhing 'dir steng rlung zas su za ba nyams len rgyun khyer gyi rim pa ni gnas shin tu dben zhing nyams dga' bar khrus bsang gtsang sbra dang ldan pas rtsa ba gsum la tshogs kyi 'khor lo phul nas rlung zas mthar phyin pa'i gsol ba btab ste stan gyi rgyab mtho ba la dzā ha bīr lus gnad rgyun khyer la gnas par bya'o lus gnad ni rkang pa g.yon pa'i rting pas 'phongs kyi bshang gci'i bar du mnan g.yas pa'i rting pa spu dkar nag mtshams dang sor mo'i rtse rnams gdan steng du btsugs lag pa gnyis pus mo g.yas g.yon gyi steng du mda' ltar bsrang lus gnad shin tu drang ba'i ngang nas rang lus tha mal pa'i sna bug g.yas nas pho rlung zhes pa'am drag rlung ngam rtsub rlung zhes pa lan gsum du mda' ltar 'phangs pas zhe sdang las gyur pa thams cad kha dog dmar po'i rnam par dpag tshad rgyang grags

phyi yi rgya mtsho'i pha mthar nad gdon sdig sgrib grib dang mi gtsang ba rtswa dug rlung dug thig le'i nyes skyon nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa thams cad du ba nag bun rnag khrag chu ser sdig pa sdom sbal pa 'bu srin sol khu dud khu'i rnam par nag 'du ru ru thon par bsam la lus sprugs dmigs pa dang bstun te bya'o de bzhin du sna bug g.yon nas mo rlung zhes pa'am las rlung bag chags kyi rlung gsum 'jam pos lan gsum kha dog ser po'i rnam par nyon mongs pa 'dod chags las gyur pa thams cad dbyung ngo dbus nas ma ning zhes pa'am mnyam rgyu'i rlung ngam nyon mongs kyi rlung sogs gti mug las gyur pa thams cad kha dog nag po'i rnam par sa 'og rim pa dgu'i nang du gong gi dmigs pa dang bcas dbyung ngo de nas thabs shes zung 'jug gi rlung dal bar bzhag pa'i ngang nas mi mno mi bsam lhang nge ba bzo med ka dag gi ngang la bzhag go skabs 'dir 'ja' lus rdo rje'i tshig rkang las dbu ma 'ja' lus gsal stong 'dzin med bsgom zhes pas rang lus dbu ma khyad chos bzhi ldan rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas su zug cing gdengs ka che ba spyi bor bstan pa rang lus kyi tshad tsam phyi sngo ba nang shin tu dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa yar sna zla ba'i ngo bo thig le dkar po rnam pa ril ba bya ma sar gyi sgo nga tsam 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba gcig gsal btab mar sna thig le dmar po'i rnam pa ril ba bya ma sar gyi sgo nga tsam gcig gsal btab de yang dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bar snang dwangs pa'i 'ja' tshon ltar gsal stong 'dzin med du sgom pa ni dmigs pa chu bo'i rgyun gyi nyams len gal che'o de nas mnyam rlung tshar gcig bus rjes phyi rol gyi bcud sa rlung ser po chu rlung dkar po me rlung dmar po rlung gi rlung ljang gu nam mkha'i rlung sngon po gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma nor lha gter bdag

sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal 'byung ba brtan g.yo snod bcud kyi dwangs ma thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par khra bun nu nu byung nas rang lus dbu mar thim dbu ma chos 'byung yang 'ja' tshon gyi rnam par 'dzam gling 'od kyis khyab pa gcig tu bsam de nas rlung zhi ba btsan thabs drag po gsum la re re la nyi shu rtsa gcig re thun drug drug tu za'o rlung za ma nus par le lo g.yengs ba dpa' zhum byas na yon tan mi skye bas 'dir bshad pa bzhin za bar gal che'o rlung zhi bar za ba hub sgras kha so gnyis kyi bar nas 'dren no btsan thabs su za ba kha sna btsum pa'i sgang la rlung rig mid pa nas sgra bcas kyis mid drag por za ba g.yas g.yon gsum gsum nas kha sgra bcas mid pa sgra bcas kyi 'jug pa'o gsum ka pho ba gang bar ma gyur gyi bar du za'o de thams cad kyi nyams len dmigs gnad zab mo rnams zhal las shes par bya'o nyams len ma 'byongs bar spang bya gsum ni steng rlung sgregs pa 'og rlung 'dor ba spang zas reg dri ma me dang nyi ma spang tsha skyur sngo ngad byug bdug spang bar bya rgyun khyer gsum ni lus ma yengs pa dbu ma 'dzug bskor 'then gsum lus sbyong 'phrul 'khor bskyed rim dang nyi zla bskor ba dang mi 'bral bar bya'o ngag ma yengs pa steng 'og bar gsum rlung rtsol 'byung lnga'i bcud sdud rlung 'tsho bcud 'tsho dang ma bral bar bya'o yid ma yengs pa chos 'byung byang sems dkar dmar lhun grub rnam gsum gyi ngang la ma bcos ka dag tu bzhag go skabs skabs su rlung gru bshud nyi zla bskor ba rnams res mos su nyams su blangs pas mthun rkyen nyams rtogs nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar rgyas pa'o zhes de ltar tshe gcig lus gcig gis mtshungs med 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i dmar khrid sangs rgyas lag bcangs su gdams pa'i zab khrid tshang la ma nor rdzogs pa 'di nyid nyams snang za zir du byung ba la brten te dung dkar rgya mtsho'i rus ming gi tha shal sprang po nyi zla klong gsal gyis dus tshes nges med du ber chen dben pa'i ri khrod du nyams len ngang nas yi ger bkod pa'o

tshe gcig 'od phung mchog sgrub zab chos 'di dbang med lung med dmar khrid nyams myong med dpe bltas tshig zin kha chos gzu lum byed chos min bstan bshig dam nyams ma lus kun snying khrag dwangs ma gza' bdud zhal du bzhes badz+ra rā hu la rak+ṣa si hūm̐ ྈ 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las gtum mo rdzogs rim zung 'jug 'khor 'das rang grol bzhugs so na mo gu ru dzā ha bīr ma hā su kha sid+dhi pha la ho rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal zhing des gsung theg pa'i yang rtse mchog bogs 'don gtum mo'i dmar khrid 'di las ldan don du cung zad bri chos bdag mkha' 'gros gnang du gsol 'ja' lus rdo rje'i tshig rkang las nyams rtogs rtsa ba rtsa rlung thig le yin zhes pas nyi ma'i ngo bo thig le dmar po la brten nas gtum mo gos su gyon pa la gsum ste lus rtsa gnad dang ldan pa ngag rlung gnad dang ldan pa sems dmigs gnad dang ldan pa'i ngang nas hūm̐ ye stong ka dag spros bral rang mdangs las snod kyi 'jig rten dag pa mkha' spyod gnas bcud kyi sems can rgyal yum phag mor gyur skye med chos 'byung dmar nag yangs pa'i nang pad+ma nyi zla bam ro brtsegs pa'i steng rang lus rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo'i sku dmar gsal brkyang bskum gri gug thod khrag 'dzin spyi gtsug phag gdong kha ṭ+wāṃ bde nyams sgyur gcer bu skra grol thod skam lnga yis brgyan me dpung dmar nag klong na 'gying bag bzhugs skabs 'dir bzlas pa ci rigs byed pa zhal las shes gu ru hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ sa ma ya dzaḥdza spyi gtsug gsang gnas bar du dbu ma ni mtshan nyid bzhi ldan spro bsdu go rim bzhin bde stong zhal mjal a haṃ 'bar 'dzag bsgom bzhi gsum bcu gnyis bde stong rang zhal lta drag rlung gcun la dmigs pa lte 'og gi a thung me lce lam lam 'bar bar bsam me lce yar byung rtsa nang thams cad dros

rtsa nang ma shong lus nang thams cad gang slar yang stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad gang me yi tshwa tshwa 'ur 'ur 'bar bar bsam me lce'i rtse la ḍā ki dpag med kyis me dpung bsnams nas bro gar byed par bsam rig pa brtul zhugs bro gar drag tu bya slar yang me lce tshur byung rang la thim 'khor lo lnga la 'bar 'dzag drag tu bsgom lha tshogs gsal btab yab yum 'bros 'ded bskul gsol 'debs 'bad cing lus gnad drag tu gcun lus gnad pus 'khyud khril gnyis bsdam rlung gnad bsdig cing mgrin gcu mnan dmigs gnad gsal stong rtsa 'khor bsgom spel zhing brtsegs la 'bad pas bsnun grangs med bar du rlung 'dzin gces nyi zla skor zhing drod 'beb bya 'dren 'grem 'phrul 'khor drag tu 'bad de ltar nyams len rtsal 'byongs nas rang lus 'od rig yid rig dang bol+la'i bde ba la brten nas tshe gcig 'ja' lus 'grub 'dod na dmigs pa'i rim pa 'di ltar ro bde stong rang zhal blta zhing dwangs ma dal bus dbab gnyen po drag pos 'dzag pa med par bcing rlung sems gnyis kyis 'grangs par drang 'phrul 'khor rnam bzhis khrem par dgram zhes pas 'dod chags bdag pos bya pho mgrin snyan bsten bya pho 'gros kyis dwangs ma dal bus dbab bya pho 'gying gis 'dzag pa med par bcing bya pho 'dren gyis dwangs ma 'drongs par drang bya pho sprug gis khrem par dgram rang lus bde stong kha sbyor la 'chug med rtsa yi them bu dgos gzhan lus bde chen kha sbyor la 'chug med rlung gi them bu dgos 'khor 'das mnyam nyid kha sbyor la 'dzin med lta ba'i them bu dgos ces pas de la brtan pa thob nas gzhan lus bsten pa ni bdag nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su tha mal shes pa ma yengs par rta mgrin dbang chen sku mdog dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bsgrad g.yas g.yon gri gug thod khrag bsnams gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan ldan bsgom spyi bor yi ge ra 'od zhu

rdo rje dpa' bo sku mdog dkar g.yas g.yon rdo rje thod khrag 'dzin mgrin par yi ge tsa 'od zhu rat+na dpa' bo sku mdog ser g.yas g.yon rin chen thod khrag 'dzin snying gar hrīḥbaskyed 'od zhu bas sangs rgyas dpa' bo sku mdog mthing g.yas g.yon 'khor lo thod khrag 'dzin lte bar hri bskyed 'od zhu bas pad+ma dpa' bo sku mdog dmar g.yas g.yon pad+ma thod khrag 'dzin gsang gnas ya bskyed 'od zhu bas las kyi dpa' bo sku mdog ljang g.yas g.yon rgya gram thod khrag 'dzin de ltar gsal ba'i sku pang du rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bsgrad g.yas pas gri gug g.yon thod khrag 'khril sbyor zhal ljags dgyes pa'i tshul gcer bu rgyan ldan mdzes par bsgom de ltar bsgoms pa'i spyi gtsug tu yi ge ha bskyed 'od zhu bas rdo rje ḍā ki sku mdog dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bgrad g.yas pas gri gug g.yon thod khrag gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan bcas bskyed mgrin par ri bskyed 'od zhu bas rin chen ḍā ki sku mdog ser snying khar ma bskyed 'od zhu bas sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing lte bar ni bskyed 'od zhu bas pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar gsang gnas sa bskyed 'od zhu bas karma mkha' 'gro sku mdog ljang de ltar rig pa'i lha tshogs kyang gsal la 'dzin med sbyor bar bsam bdag nyid yab yum spyi gtsug tu pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin phyag g.yon dril bu yum la 'khyud sku pang ye shes mtsho rgyal dkar 'dzum mdzes mdangs gsal 'od zer 'phro skra grol gcer bu 'od ldan bskyed de ltar gsal btab rol pa yis tha mal pa ru mi 'gro 'o bdag gzhan bskyed rim gding med pas 'dod pas gdung ba'i chags lam kun khyi phag kun dang khyad ci yod thabs lam nyams len byed pa kun mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa dang

rang lus lha ru bskyed pa dang 'du shes gsum ldan shin tu gces rang lus gnas pa'i byang chub sems sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzhi yin zhing mkha' 'gro ma yi bzhugs gnas te phyi ru nyungs 'bru tsam bo na rig 'dzin mchog gi go 'phang dben de bas rang gzhan nyams len 'di nyams su len pa'i skyes bu ni so thar byang sems sngags sdom gyi dam tshig ma nyams rab tu bsrung tshul khrims ldan pa'i dge slong gis nyams len 'chug med brtson gyur na ting nge 'dzin 'phel byang sems rgyas rtsa khams mkha' 'gro dgyes de'i mthus lus la bde drod rtogs pa 'char snang srid lha 'dre bran bzhin khol bar chad ma dang mkha' 'gros sel thun mong mi nor zas gsum 'du 'chi tshe o rgyan mkha' spyod 'gro 'di spangs 'jig rten bud med spyod phyi ma dmyal gnas ro myag skye des na gcig brgyud gdams pa las mang na mkha' 'gro'i chad pa yong tshe thung dam nyams na raka ltung gsang ste gsang sngags nyams len 'bad rgya rgya rgya gding ldan bu yis nyams blangs na yon tan 'di rnams zla ba rgyas ltar 'byung yon tan brgyad dang phrin las bzhi mngon shes lnga dang rdzu 'phrul dang lus bde sems bde 'od gsal 'char 'gro mgyogs rgas sra tshe ring zhing bde drod 'bar zhing 'dzag sgo sdom rtsa mdud grol dang rtags bcu 'char gzhan snang bsgyur dang mkha' spyod bgrod sku gsum zhal mthong sku bzhi mtha' ru phyin don gnyis mthar phyin tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob rgyal bas rgyud dang man ngag mang gsungs kyang tshe gcig don gyi sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la mthar thug lam ni rnam pa gnyis las med steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i lam mchog dang 'og sgo bde ba chen po'i lam gnyis las 'di ni 'og sgo bde ba chen po'i lam sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpar gyur na yang sangs rgyas thob pa'i rtsa mdud grol ba la 'og sgo bde ba'i phyag rgya ma bsten na sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i go 'phang las

bcu gsum rdzogs pa'i shes rab mi thob pas brtul zhugs can gyis phyag rgya bsten pa gces bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rnams kyang rtsa mdud grol phyir las kyi phyag rgya bsten srid pa tha ma'i rnal 'byor pho mo kun man ngag bzhin du nyams blangs gyur pa na 'jig rten mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur shes rab rang bzhin sangs rgyas skyed pa'i yum thabs shes ya bral nyams len su yis byed chos sku'i zhing na yab yum 'khril sbyor bzhugs longs sku'i zhing na zung 'jug mnyam rol mdzad bde mchog kyai rdor dus 'khor gsang 'dus sogs yi dam zhi khro bde gshegs rgya mtsho kun thabs shes mi 'bral zung 'jug gcer bur 'khyud rgya gar grub thob brgyad cu rtsa lnga yang phyag rgya la bsten dngos grub rnam gnyis thob o rgyan pad+ma rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang grub chen brgya dang paṇa chen brgya rtsa brgyad phyag rgya la bsten 'ja' lus 'pho med grub rgya bod grub thob kun gyi dgongs don yin rnying ma rgyud 'bum gsar ma rgyud 'bum sogs de dag ma lus nyams len mthar thug pa phyag rgya kho nar gsungs pa ma dgongs par dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyal kun mdzad bzang la ya ga cal sgrog mu cor skur pa 'debs phyi ma dmyal ba sgrub pa a tsa ma dam nyams log rtog can la bka' rgya gdams gza' bdud chen po drang srong gza' brgyad kyis bka' 'di thub par srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa si hūm̐ ྈ

'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las shes rab ma'i nyams len gser gyi yang zhun bzhugs so na mo gu ru dzā ha bīr shes rab blo che dad ldan rigs bzang rnams ma nor lam mchog tshe gcig sangs rgyas bstan nyams su longs shig skal ldan bud med rnams zhes pas 'dir skal ldan gyi bud med rnams tshe gcig lam mchog sgrub pa'i lam nyams su len par 'dod na gong du bshad pa'i nyams len rnams la rtags thon nges su byas nas slar gsang khrid la yid ches brtan pa ma thob bar du sbyang mthar phyin nas bogs 'don thur ma'i nyams len bya ste de la'ang bzhi ste thur ma'i rgyu thur ma'i tshad 'jug pa'i tshad 'dzin gegs bsal ba dang bzhi yod pa las dang po thur ma'i tshad ni ring thung mtho gang sor bzhi bud med skyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa rnams la mthe'u chung gi tshigs dang po yan shong tsam thabs can nam 'khor ba spel la mthe bong shong tsam mo rgyu ni gser dngul zangs lcags sam be rkang stag ma bya rkang sogs gang 'byor ro 'jug tshad ni steng zhal ma zhes pa rtsa kha mdun ngos la yod pas rang sor lnga tshun tsam du'o 'og zhal can zhes pa rtsa kha rgyab ngos la yod pas sor bzhi'i tshad tsam mdun zhal can zhes pa pad+ma'i 'og sha rgyas te mas rus 'bur du yod pa yin no shor can zhes pa pad+ma'i steng gi sha rus rgyas pa rgya phibs kha phub ltar ze'u 'bru gsang ba'i mdzod thur du bltab pa'o pad+ma bde chen gsang ba'i pho brang e waṃ dkyil 'khor du sor gsum tshun chad 'gro de nas sor gsum tshun gyen la segs de nas sor gcig thur la gnon de nas sor gnyis gyen la gan te phul nas sor dgu'i sa na srid pa'i zhags pa yod sleb ma thag tu dbugs ring shugs ring 'dar skad dang yan lag 'khrab cing smar dos chad pa dang zug rngu drag po mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal du yong bas de ma thag gsang thur sor gcig phyir 'then no dbu ma dal bus btsugs nas 'jam rlung zhi bar drangs pas

zug rngu las rim gyis rgyal bar 'gyur bas sgyid ma lug par stong 'dren stod mnan sgang 'dren sgang mnan byas pas thur rlung gyen la rgyug pa'i tshe 'ja' 'od du me re 'byung ste lus thams cad gang bar bsam de nas thur ma dal bus 'then zhing 'jam rlung bzung nas pho ba g.yas skor rdo rje tho rdeg sogs la 'bad pas zhag bdun tshun la gsang thur 'byongs par the tshom med chu gtong skabs kyi snga phyi thams cad la rnag khrag dum pa re yong ba dang rtsa chu re mos su sdom pa rgyu smad dang lte ba brgyud de zug drag po long bas de rnams la bred snang mi dgos khad kyi na zug las rgyal bar 'gyur ro de nas chu'am mar sogs gang rung stobs 'thung tshod dang sbyar nas rim par 'dren no snying rus bskyed la pad+ma dung 'bud pad+ma sgra 'byin khrag 'thung rnams la rtags ma byung bar du bskyed do gegs sel ni go zlog 'phrul 'khor sgra gcan che chung dang bsgrad 'beb la sogs gzhung gi 'phrul 'khor la 'bad par bya'o an tsam zug che nas mi bzod na rdzas sman byug 'phying dron bdug cing bku byugs thems par bya chang gsar rus khu dkar gsum mngar gsum dkor nag log 'tsho ma yin pa rnams dang du blang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i srog 'phrog pa'i dkor zas spangs la srin po rlung zas rlung 'tshos dus 'da' bar byas la gnas g.ya' khrod gangs khrod du sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i dga' ston la 'bad 'tshal lo de ltar 'bad pa'i yon tan ni mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gsum du mdangs ldan nu ma med nyi ma tshangs zhugs gtsug tor ltar mi mngon mchog gi sku gsum mngon gyur lam 'di 'grub ces dang bag med du byas na rgyud las skye ba dman pa'i byang sems de sa chu me rlung gis khyer nas lha klu sa bdag tshogs rnams kun nad yams dal gyis 'thibs nas su kun gyi grong khyer brlag par 'gyur bdag med khyi mo'i lus blangs nas

thar med gnas su ltung bar 'gyur zhes pa la sogs pa'i nyes ltung mang por gsungs kyang cung zad mang ches pas ma bris de rnams ni sngon du 'gro ba dang dngos gzhi'i skor ro rjes kyi rim pa la gsum ste 'ja' lus rdo rje'i tshig rkang las gegs sel yon tan skyed pa'i thabs la 'bad ces pas sman dang sngags 'phrul 'khor gyi gegs sel dang gsum las dang po 'phrul 'khor gyi gegs sel ni rdo rje'i lus 'dul dwangs snyigs dbye ba dang nyi zla sgra gcan gegs sel che chung bya phyi nang gsang gsum 'bod chen 'bod chung dang gsang ba'i skyil krung nyi zla go bzlog bya g.yang mo'i sprug dang seng sprug ha sprug 'bad shes rab ma yi gegs sel 'phrul 'khor ro 'phrul 'khor byed tshe dmigs gnad 'di nyid gces yar la langs dus phag mo'i nga rgyal bskyed 'beb pa'i dus su snang srid 'od skur 'khyil 'dren pa'i dus su nyi zla tshangs rtser gnon dgram pa'i dus su sku thig tshom bur blta ngal gso'i dus su ka dag gnas lugs ngang rang lus gnas pa'i lha tshogs ma lus kun 'od lnga tshom bu'i klong du khra shig ge dwangs ma 'od gsal ngo bor 'od mer re gsal stong zung 'jug ngang du cham gdal le mnyam nyid ye grol ngang du rjen hrig ge 'khor gsum dmigs med ngang du bde nyams skyongs 'phrul 'khor bzhag tshe smon lam 'di ltar bya lus lha sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs ngag sngags su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs yid ka dag 'grub par byin= rtsa rlung thig le 'byongs par byin= 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par= tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par= zhing khams rnam dag 'byongs par= 'brel tshad don dang ldan par= rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par= gdod ma'i rang zhal mjal bar byin gyis rlobs rā hu la rak+ṣa si hūm̐ ྈ 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las gegs sel bdud rtsi'i char 'beb dngos grub myur stsol bzhugs so na mo gu ru dzā ha bīr

gdod ma'i gnas lugs mngon gyur cing snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su rang grol lhun grub 'od kyi sku 'ja' lus mkha' spyod dngos grub brnyes rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug dzā ha bīr gyis gdams pa zab mo'i nyams len byed pa'i skal ldan pho mo rnams kyi gegs sel bdud rtsi'i char 'beb 'dod dgu'i bang mdzod dngos grub myur stsol 'di la bzhi ste rlung gi sbyor ba la brten nas gegs sel ba dang dmigs pa la brten nas gegs sel ba dang sman la brten nas gegs sel ba dang sngags la brten nas gegs sel ba dang bzhi'o dang po stod nad gzer ba sel ba'i dmigs pa ni rang gi khog stod thams cad lcags tshags kyi mig ltar yod pa'i nang nas rnag khrag chu ser nad gdon thams cad shor sgra dang bcas te thon par bsam la stod kyi rlung srang du khu tshur brdeg pa dang ha 'don drag tu bya'o gnyis pa smad nad sbos khrog sel ba'i dmigs pa ni rang gi pho bar gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa lte bar raṃ gyi 'og tu yaṃ gyis mtshan pa yaṃ las rlung byung raṃ las me 'bar gnam lcags me yi 'khor lo drag tu 'khor bas lus ye shes kyi mes gang bar bsams nas pho ba g.yas g.yon drag tu bskor zhing rdo rje tho rdeg dang drod 'beb kyi 'phrul 'khor la 'bad do gsum pa steng rlung 'gags pa sel ba'i dmigs pa ni rang gi mgrin pa nas rlung thams cad sngo phyu ru ru 'og sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sir sgra dang bcas don par bsam zhing mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon thams cad nas gzhil ba'o bzhi pa smad rlung dbugs ngan bsgoms pa'i dmigs pa ni ka ba btsugs la smad rlung gyen la drangs nas rlung thams cad sngo phyu ru ru spyi bo'i gtsug nas yar thon te mda' gang tsam gyi thad du shel dkar mchod rten gyi rnam par chags pas de rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsam la 'beb chung ha sgra dang bcas pa'o

lnga pa snying rlung sel ba'i dmigs pa ni rang gi glo snying thams cad dmar khra le ba khrol tshags lta bu nas rnag khrag chu ser thams cad sgra dang bcas te 'dzag par bsam la tsog 'beb 'phrul 'khor gyis sel lo drug pa chu ser sel ba'i dmigs pa ni rang lus sha khrag med par rus krang du bsam pa'i stod smad bar gsum khrol tshags lta bu kha mang po yod pa nas chu ser thams cad rlung gis bdas te phyir 'ur sgra dang bcas te thon par bsam mo bdun pa mig sna sor mo la 'dren pa'i dmigs pa ni rang lus thams cad rtsa'i drwa bar 'brel bas de thams cad kyi rtse yan lag gi sor mo dang sna mig rnams la zug rtsa'i rtse thams cad sog phon gyi mgo bo breg pa ltar sbu gu ha re yod pa nas rlung thams cad bun bun thon par bsam mo brgyad pa pus nad sel ba dang rkang mgyogs kyi gegs sel ni de la rkang mgyogs kyi dmigs gnad gong du bstan cing pus nad sel ba'i lus gnad har langs dang pus steng khu tshur gsum bsnun cing rgyab nas sgyid khug gsum bsnun dang rting par shad rjes 'then skyod gang mang dang skabs rer thog la 'jus te rkang pa brkyang bskum res mos su byed do bar skabs su 'phred ma sogs la rkang rtse sar btsugs nas gnam sgreng du rgyug go skabs su rkang mthil thams cad bug pa'i rang bzhin nas tshigs nad thams cad rnag khrag chu ser gyi rnam par don par dmigs pa'o dgu pa sha lhad 'don pa'i dmigs pa ni rang lus me ru 'ur sgra dang bcas nas 'bar nas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad tshig nang khrol sha khrag thams cad phyir thon nas lus phru ma phus btab pa lta bur gsal te dgram 'dren la 'bad sman la brten pa'i gegs sel ni stod smad kyi sbos khrog gzer langs nad rigs 'joms pa ni chu rtsa dreg pa dang snum med pa bya brun thar nu cha mnyam la thur mgo gang tsam chu bskol lcag gis phul chu skol theb gsum la btang

rlung zhi drag gang mang bcug nas srin po gre 'gags kyis gnad la dbab pas nad thams cad bshal du 'byung ba'o chu skol gang 'thung thub thub yang yang btang bas rlung yar 'gying na mar mnan pas mthar chu mdog nam thon thon bshal lo me drod gso ba'i drod sman ni se 'bru sug smel shing tsha pi pi ling bzhi cha snyoms la rgya tsha zhad tsam btang zhib btags rna brus gang gi tshad tsam chu grang gis phul btang thun tshad tsha grang dang sbyar chu bsdoms zhi srin lcam 'bru sdig srin drod sman pi pi ling g.yer ma gze ma rnams cha snyoms rgya tsha zhad tsam btang ba'i thang dang po sla bar du gar mthar sla ba ci mang btang bal 'dab gtsang ma la sngags 'di brgya rtsa bsgrangs la chu sor sbyar oṃ chu shad shad dmar nar nar sa chal chal chu thon thon swā hā des nad las grol bar 'gyur ro gzhan yang rlung gi nad phal che ba la rus gsar gyi thang mkhris pa la a ru ra gser mdog gi thang bad kan skya smug sogs gang la'ang tsha la bul tog cong zhi lga skya rnams cha snyoms zhib tu btags shing chu bskol gyis phul nas btang bas nad thams cad bshal du 'byung ngo sha dug sbyar dug sogs kyis nad lhongs pa la rlung la 'bad cing dri chu skor log byas pas steng 'og gi grang ba'i nad byang zhing gso ba'i sman du 'gyur ro sa bdag klu'i nad 'don na thog mar rlung la 'byongs par byas la gnyen po'i sman ni bse zho zho gang thar nu zho phyed sman chen zho gang gser mdog zho bzhi gla rtsi zho lnga ra khrag nag po zho lnga pad+ma dmar khra bar gshog phral ba bcu gcig rgya tsha zho phyed pi pi ling rdog po gsum shing mngar sran ma tsam sdig srin thun bzang ba gsum gyi bongs lcam 'bru thun lnga gze ma thun lnga rma bya'i mdongs gsum rus sbal dang spir gyi rus pa zho re de rnams zhib tu btags la tsan+dan mar khus bsdus pa'i ril bu sran chung tsam re nangs res brten rlung la 'bad pas nad rnams rang 'byongs su 'byung zhing sos par nges so

mid pa rgyun gcod kyi skabs su thog mar sgog skya'i thang phran bu btang bas 'byung ba cha snyoms chu bskol grang dro gang 'thung yang oṃ thud de thud de thud swā hā brgya rtsa bzlas chu la btab ste 'thung ngo chu dug zhi zhing chu stobs bskyed pa'o mid pa rgyun gcod mi byed skabs su dkar gsum mngar gsum chang zhim po dum re btang bas ting nge 'dzin 'phel bar 'gyur ro mig rab rib tu gyur nas mi gsal na a ru ra'i thang snas dri mi tshor na sha chen gyi gsur skyug log byung na 'bu yin pas sgog thang btang ba'am la phug gi dri ma bsnom lces ro tshor ba shor na bsregs sha kham bu re za dri chen ma thon na tshwa mar kham gcig gtang grang ba skyes na lga spod kyi thang gtang khyom khyom rdib na ka ra chu skol gtong rlung langs na phye mar dud pas 'dug bad kan langs na bca' sga'i phye ma chu grang btab la btang mar nag sngo dang sha rtsam chang skyur lan tshwa spang me dang nyi mar mi sdod bud med la mi 'khrig zhag nyer gcig gis rang so zin zla ba gcig gis 'byung ba cha snyoms zla ba gnyis nas lus shing bal ltar yang gsum nas 'byung ba cha snyoms rig pa dwangs snyigs phyed bzhi nas ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab skye lnga nas mngon shes 'char drug nas bla ma mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub 'byung rgan po'i skyon bral 'chi bdag bdud las rgyal 'phro gcod na dang po dal gyis bza' btung brten zhing chung chung dang nyung nyung nas bslab par bya'o de la goms pas gegs mi 'byung ste yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro yon tan gyi mngon rtags byung na rlom pas nga rgyal dregs chos mi bya lhongs kyi rnam pas cung zad ma bde ba byung yang sgyid lug dpa' zhum nas 'phro mi gcod mi bde ba rgyun bsrings nas bder ma song na ha cang nan cher mi bya bar 'phro dal gyis gcad bzang ngan gyi rnam pa ci byung yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go

de la sogs pa'i rnam bzhag 'os pa dang mi 'os pa rnams gdams pa spyi dang bstun zhing rnal 'byor pa nyams rtogs can gyis shes par bya'o 'di'i yon tan thun re bsgoms pas kyang tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel ba la sogs pa'i don 'bras dpag tu med pa 'byung bar 'gyur na rgyun du nyams su blangs na brjod las 'das pa'i yon tan thob par 'gyur ro sa ma ya rak+ṣa rā hu la ྈ 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las khyad par 'phags pa'i khrid chen brgyad dang 'byung ba'i gegs sel bzhugs so ྈ na mo gu ru dzā ha bīr a yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi hūm̐ 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug dzā ha bīr gyi khyad par 'phags pa'i khrid chen brgyad kyi zur dmigs 'di sngon chad ma dar kyang deng nas bla ma mkha' 'gros ldom bu ba bdag nyid la nyams zir du gnang ba yi ger bris pa snang yang dad ldan rnams kyi snying nor sa ma ya na mo gu ru dzā ha bīr dad ldan tshe gcig thar pa thob 'dod rnams tshe sgrub zab mos rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bde drod gtum mos bag chags gnyis 'dzin bsreg rlung lnga'i dwangs ma ye shes zas bcud 'tshol rkang mgyogs rlung gis mkha' spyod dngos grub bsgrub chu rlung zab mos skom pa'i tsha gdung sel btung ba'i bye brag phyi nang bcud sdud bya rtsa ba'i rlung lngas phyi nang bar chad sel rlung 'tsho bcud 'tshos bkrag mdangs gzi brjid bskyed khams la dbang thob mkha' spyod myur bgrod 'gyur zhes pas dang po tshe sgrub kyi zhal shes ni rang lus gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu par bsgom ste de'i lte bar rlung sems kyi ngo bo nyi zla'i gwa'u 'od 'bar ba'i nang du mgon po tshe dpag med longs sku'i cha lugs gsal btab kha so gnyis kyi bar nas ha sib kyis rlung rngubs pas bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dpa' mo dang skye 'gro mchog dman bar gsum brtan g.yo snod bcud kyi tshe bcud thams cad tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'bar gyi nus mthur bkug nas nyi zla'i gwa'ur thim pas bkrag mdangs 'od du 'tsher ba la dmigs pa gtad

gzungs sngags 'di nyid rlung za ba dang bstun te bzla'o oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe bh+rūm̐ nṛ dza de ltar yang yang byas pas tshe 'phel bar 'gyur u pa de sha gnyis pa gtum mo'i zhal gdams ni lus gnad rgyun khyer ltar la rang lus phag mor gsal btab rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan dang chos 'byung rnam gsum bsgoms nas rlung drag tu gcun dmigs pa lte 'og tu a raṃ me 'bar la gtad do me lce yar yar 'bar lus thams cad gang me lce'i rtse la mkha' 'gro ma grangs med kyi phyag na ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba bsnams pa ste thams cad kyang bro gar byed par bsam la drod 'beb tsog 'beb dang brtul zhugs kyi 'phrul 'khor la drag tu 'bad pas bde drod rang dbang med par 'bar ro sbas chos u pa de sha'o gsum pa rlung lnga'i zhal gdams ni rlung shas can gyi gang zag la 'byung ba sa'i bcud sra zhing 'thas pa lci ba ser por gsal btab ste rngub pa'o tshad shas can la 'byung ba chu'i bcud bsil zhing dwangs pa kha dog dkar po reg bya bsil ba rngub par bya'o grang shas che na 'byung ba me'i bcud dmar zhing 'tsher ba tsha ngar ldan pa rngub par bya'o bad kan gyis bying shas che na 'byung ba rlung gi bcud yangs shing g.yo ba sir sgra dang bcas rngub pa'o rig pa la gsal cha med na 'byung ba nam mkha'i rlung mtha' dbus gzhom gzhig dang bral ba sngon por rngub pa'o rlung lnga'i zhal gdams u pa de sha'o bzhi pa rkang mgyogs rlung gi zhal gdams ni gsang rlung rta ru zhon par 'dod na 'gro tshe steng rlung mnan 'og rlung 'then rkang 'og gnyis su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can changs gzung la yaṃ mchog ma ba dan gyis mtshan pa 'gro tshe lag pa gnyis kyi srin lag gi 'phar rtsa mthe bong gis mnan pa'i khu tshur bcang mchan rtsa bcings te yaṃ las rlung g.yos ba dan bskyod nas btegs pa'i tshul du dmigs la gom zor yang chod kyis btang la phyin pas mi phal pa las dgu 'gyur gyis mgyogs shing

mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob bo 'di'i skabs su rkang mgyogs kyi 'phrul 'khor dang pus nad sel ba'i 'phrul 'khor gling bzhi bsgrad pa'i 'phrul 'khor dang mi 'bral bar bya'o rlung gnad bum pa can la 'bad pa u pa de sha'o lnga pa chu rlung skom du 'thung ba'i zhal shes ni lus skyil krung phyed pa mda' ltar bsrang lkog ma dang mid pa mdun du brgyang rang rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog dkar mor gsal rtsa nang thams cad rdo rje mkha' 'gro grangs med pas mer gyis khengs par sgom zhing chu rlung dkyil 'khor phyi'i chu rlung thams cad mgrin pa ldem gug gis ha sib kyis so bar nas drangs pas rang lus kyi rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis sogs kyi grangs can dang grangs med kyi rtsa thams cad sog phon gyi mgo bregs pa lta bu sbu gu ha re khrag chu ser gyis ma gang ba stong sang nge yod pa'i nang du chu'i bcud thams cad dkar nar re zhugs pas lus phru ma bus pa ltar bdud rtsis dkar mer gyis gang bar bsam mo zhag gsum nas brtan pa thob cing skom pa'i gdung ba las grol phyis skom pa'i tshe dran pa tsam gyis chog pa'o chu rlung gi u pa de sha'o drug pa rlung hub dbar du bza' ba'i zhal shes ni chu bskol chu grang dar chu 'o chu khrus chu rdo chu ja la sogs pa 'thung ba'i tshe hub sgra dang bcas pas sa chu me rlung 'byung lnga'i bcud dang dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje byin rlabs bsod nams thams cad 'ja' 'od du me re re byung nas btung ba dang mnyam du rang lus 'ja' 'od kyis khengs par bsam nas mid pa'o 'di tshe sgrub kun gyi rtsa ba'i mthar thug tu gyur pa yin no rlung hub dbar du bza' ba'i u pa de sha'o bdun pa rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i phyi nang bar chad sel ba'i zhal shes ni dang po sa rlung za ba'i tshe lus gnad dzā ha bīr rgyun khyer ltar la lte 'og a raṃ gsal btab mgo gug pas phyi rol sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad nas laṃ las sa bcud ser po 'jam la thung ba'i tshul du rngub cing 'bud do

gnyis pa chu rlung bza' tshe rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung mthe bong lag gnyis kyis bzung nas ro stod bsgyed cing snying gar hūm̐ mthing nag 'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba la sems gtad de phyi rol sor bcu gsum tsam nas khaṃ las chu rlung dkar po 'jam la ring ba so dbar nas rngub cing 'bud do gsum pa me rlung zas su bza' ba'i tshe skyil krung mig gnyis bsgril rna ba'i bug pa gnyis bsangs te yan lag thams cad sprug cing phyogs bzhir 'khrab pa'i ngang nas phyi rol sor bcu gsum tsam las raṃ las me rlung dmar po rtsub thung dum bur rngub cing 'bud do bzhi pa rlung gi rlung bza' tshe gyad kyi 'dug stangs drag shul gyi ngang nas phyi rol sor bco lnga tshad tsam las yaṃ las rlung gi rlung drag po sgra can gyis rngub cing 'dud do lnga pa nam mkha'i rlung zas su bza' ba'i tshe lus gnad tsog pu 'then slong gi ngang nas phyi rol sor bcu drug tsam nas e las nam mkha'i rlung sngon po shin tu 'jam pa'i ngang nas rngub cing 'bud do rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i u pa de sha'o brgyad pa rlung 'tsho'i zhal shes ni lus gnad ri bong tsog sdod kyi ngang nas ka ba btsugs pa glang po chu srin ne tso sogs kyis rlung lha rgya mtshor spyan drangs pa zug gzer sbos khrog sogs na zug gang byung yang thun chung ngu nas bslab pas zug rngu mtha' dag las rgyal bar 'gyur ro de ltar rlung 'tsho bcud 'tsho la brtan pa thob pas 'chi bdag gi bdud las rgyal bar 'gyur ro rlung 'tsho mthar phyin pa'i rtags su bdud rtsi kha dog dmar po dang ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po dang ljang khu la sogs 'gyur na rnal 'byor pa'i mdog kyang de ltar du nges par 'gyur ro 'di'i gnad la thur srog la bsre ba'i rlung rtsol la 'bad pa 'don pa gal che'o phyi dbang po bkrag mdangs kyi rgyan gyis mdzes pas sus mthong yang lta na sdug pa dang nang rig pa 'od gsal gyi rgyan gyis mdzes pas gzhan snang zil gyis non pa dang

gzhan yang phyi rol gyi zas bcud thams cad dbang du 'dus pa dang tha mal bza' btung gi mngon zhen chod pa dge sbyor 'phel rig pa dwangs dbang po gsal lus ngag yid gsum la nyams rtogs 'bar te nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang mngon shes 'char chu la mi bying ba sogs yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo shin tu zab pa'i man ngag rgyal po 'di brgyud pa 'dzin nges pa dang skal ldan snying rus can gyi gang zag la bstan no gzhan rnams la bka' rgya shin tu dam par bya'o rā hu la rak+ṣa sa ma ya hūm̐

ྈ 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las bogs 'don nad brgya sman gcig bdud rtsi 'chi sos bzhugs so na mo gu ru dzā ha bīr 'ja' lus rdo rje'i tshig rkang las tshe yi 'gal rkyen mi mthun kun 'joms shing tsha grang bad mkhris nad rnams bshal skyug 'byin mthun rkyen nyams rtogs nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rgyas zhes pa'i don la gsum ste rang lus kyi nad thams cad rlung gis bshal skyug tu 'byin pa dang 'phrul 'khor gyis bshal skyug 'byin pa dang sman gyis bshal skyug 'byin pa dang gsum dang po ni rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'di dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing khams su bsgom e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum kha sbyor yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bdag nyid rdo rje phag mo zhal phyag yongs rdzogs su gsal ba'i sku sked man chad ye shes me rlung 'tshubs pa'i nang du bzhugs par bsam de'i spyi bor brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs par gsal btab ste gsol ba drag tu 'debs par bya'o na mo rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa khyed rnams la sgo gsum gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na lus ngag yid la sku gsung thugs zhugs nas rgyab rlung myur grol mdun rlung mthar phyin nas srog thur ma bu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs ltau gos zhen pa chod par byin gyis rlobs rlung sems dbu mar chud par byin gyis rlobs bde stong lhan skyes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs zhes gsol ba btab pas lha tshogs dgyes nas 'od du rim gyis zhu thams cad rang nyid la mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du rang la thim de nas lus gnad sdong po gsum bltab la rlung gnad ka ba gcig pa ste pus gnyis bar du skum khru gang brla rting sprad la srin zhal du ljon shing lho'i bcud mchog lcags sam smyug ma'i thur ma sbom phra ran pa ring thung mtho gang sor bzhi pa
