bud+dha badz+ra dharma dang saṅgha shrī gdong sme can de lnga zab chos 'di yi bdag res 'ga' sba zhing res 'ga' spel ma nor brtag pa rim gyis gyis gcig brgyud gcig la sprod pa las mang na rtsa ba'i dam 'gal zhing drang srong gza' bdud chen po yis bka' chad drag pos bsdig par 'gyur thams cad 'ja' lus sku thob shog snyigs dus chos log dar ba'i dus rnal 'byor snying gi thig le 'di las can rnams dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yatsit+tarabarda thim zhal shes gnad kyi man ngag ni nyams len zab mo'i dus kyi tshe dang por nam langs nyi shar bar rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang dkar dmar mdangs phyag g.yas shel gyi phreng ba dang g.yon pa rnam rgyal a ru ra dug lnga 'joms pa'i sman mchog 'dzin 'ja' 'od klong na skyil krung bzhugs sku las 'od zer dkar po 'phros nad gdon bar chad dgra bgegs dang rkyen ngan mi kha byur gsum zhi rlung ni zhi ba'i tshul gyis za de nas nyin gung tshun chad du rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr dar babs tshul 'chang ser gsal mdangs phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pa tshe bum 'dzin 'ja' zer klong na phyed skyil bzhugs 'od zer ser po phyogs bcur 'phros tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dang mi nor zas gsum snyan grags dang ma lus thams cad dbang bsdus nas rlung ni btsan thabs dag gis za nyi ma phyed nas dgong myur tshun rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr bsgres pa'i tshul 'chang dmar smug mdangs phyag g.yas 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang g.yon pas pad phreng dmar po 'dzin nyi dkyil dbus su rol stabs bzhugs sku las 'od dmar lcags kyu'i tshul steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'phros khams gsum srid gsum ma lus dang skye 'gro pho mo ma lus dang lha srin sde brgyad mi ma yin ma lus dbang bsdus bran du khol rlung ni drag po'i tshul du rngub dgong myur dag nas srod chen bar rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr

khro tshul ljang sngon 'od zer 'phro phyag g.yas sgrol ba'i rtse gsum dang g.yon pas nyi zer zhags pa bsnams chos 'byung klong na rngams tshul bzhugs sku las 'od zer mtshon cha'i tshul dpag med phyogs bcur 'phros pa yis bstan dgra sgos dgra sku dgra dang zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs tshar bcad bsam 'og rlung rngub cing steng rlung drang gnam lcags 'khor los dum bur gtubs rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam snyigs ma phyir 'bud dwangs ma rngub dgra bo'i sha khrag drod dbugs dang phung khams skye mched ma lus pa drang srong gza' brgyad zhal du bstab lhag ma rjes shul med par bsam zhi rgyas dbang drag las sbyor dang chos skyong chen po'i drag bskul rnams ma hā yo ga'i zhal las shes 'di ltar zab pa'i mthar thug 'di snyigs dus dug lnga rags pa'i dus gzhan la ston pa'i chos min kyang las 'phro skal ba can rnams la ma bzod brtse bas snying nas bton snying gi snying thig yang gsang 'di dad ldan snying gi dkyil du chongs mos ldan rnams la gtad rgya gyis snying rus can gyis nyams su longs chos bzhin byed dang 'phrad par shog 'gro kun 'khor ba dong sprugs nas thams cad gdod ma'i sar grol shog drang srong chen pos bka' 'di srungs 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las bka' srung gza' bdud kyi gsol ka dgra bgegs myur sgrol bzhugs so badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ de lta bu'i zab lam mkha' spyod myur bgrod kyi nyams len byed pa'i skal ldan rnams kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bsal ba dang bstan dgra thal bar brlag pa'i mtshon cha drang srong gza' brgyad kyi gsol kha ni thog mar rten gtor gyi byin rlabs ni oṃ oṃ gyis phyi nang stong nyid ngang āḥ.āḥlas bhan+dha'i gtor snod yangs pa'i nang hūm̐ r+n+ri tri yongs gyur dgra bgegs gdug pa can ma lus tshar bcad sha khrag rus pa rnams dmar nag lbu ba 'khrigs pa'i rgya mtshor gyur oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod

mdun bskyed ni mdun du khrag mtsho dmar nag 'khyil ba'i klong dam nyams ru tra'i baṃ gyi gdan steng du ra yig nag po 'od zhu don gnyis byas 'jigs byed khyab 'jug chen po sgra gcan 'dzin dud kha mgo dgu sku lus mig gis gang phyag gnyis mda' gzhu zhags pa dgra la 'debs sku smad sbrul mjug 'jigs pa'i gar dgur ldan lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung 'khor gyis bskor me dud dmar nag klong du gsal bar bskyed hri shag ru raṃ nā ga tsit+ta traṃ ma ma yoṃ za 'gram ha he yo ke she la ke ta ke ta dzaḥdza bzlas pa bya spyan 'dren ni hūm̐ sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje gshegs su gsol 'dod chags zhe sdang 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas lha chen gza' bdud chen po gshegs su gsol 'jig rten srid pa yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas drang srong gza' chen brgyad po gshegs su gsol phyogs bzhi nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas sring mo gdong mo mched bzhi gshegs su gsol bzhugs su gsol ba ni dam nyams ru tra bam ro'i gdan steng du drag po'i phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhugs su gsol pad+ma ru tra tiṣ+ṭha lhan phyag 'tshal ba ni ba dag cag lus ngag yid gsum dad pa yis mnyam nyid dag pa'i ngang du phyag 'tshal lo phyi mchod 'bul ba ni ar+ghaṃ bdug spos me tog mar me dri zhal zas sil snyan phyi mchod sna tshogs 'bul nang mchod ni gzugs sgra dri ro rtsi bcud rnam lnga dang rin chen sna lnga sman raka gtor gsum 'bul gsang mchod 'bul ba ni gsang mchod dam nyams bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus phung khams bla tshe srog dbugs bzhes su gsol rā hu la pak+ṣi mi ke ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar dang ba lin+ta pañca rak+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi bstod pa na ི hūm̐ bh+yo mthu stobs dregs pa'i gtso bo rā hu la dbu dgu spyan stong sbrul rigs lnga yis brgyan mda' gzhu zhags pas bstan pa'i dgra bo sgrol gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod

phrin las bcol ba ni hūm̐ bstan bshig dam nyams ru tra ma lus pa'i tshe srog dwangs ma ma lus bsdus nas kyang lus sems phrol la sems kyi mar me sod ming tsam med par thal ba'i rdul du rlogs rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod de nas gtor ma 'bul zhing thal mo brdab bo dzā bīr gtong skabs rnams su 'di nyid gtor bsngos ma chag par bya ba ni gal che'o zhes pa ni snyigs dus kyi sprang po nyi zla klong gsal 'ja' lus snang stong rang grol kho bo bas mtha' ri khrod gnyan khrod dur khrod lung stong rnams su tshe 'di'i lto gos longs spyod snyan grags thams cad blos btang nas sgom pa'i tshe dag snang phran bu byung ba rnams tsit+ta'i dkyil du sbas nas su la'ang ma bstan kyangadad ldan mang pos yang yang bskul ba'i ngor yi ger bris pa'o chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol rā hu la rak+ṣa si hūm̐ ྈ 'ja' lus snang stong rang grol las rgyab mdun gnyis kyi yig chung lde mig rang grol bzhugs so na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī 'dir rgyab thur dang mdun thur skabs kyi yig chung bka' rgya ma las ldan tshe 'di blos btang phung po 'ja' lus zag med du 'grub par 'dod pa rnams skyabs sems sngon 'gro rnams gong ltar dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs rang gi spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa 'od lnga 'bar ba'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug dzā ha bīr zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas seng ldeng gi ḍā ru 'khrol zhing g.yon 'chi med tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs la ral chings me tog sna tshogs kyi tshom bus brgyan pa sku mdog smug nag 'od dang 'od zer du 'phro ba zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i steng du bzhugs pa'akhor bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs dang bcas pa 'od phung 'ja' zer gyi klong na bzhugs par gsal btab

gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus gong dang mthun bsdu na ma hā su kha dz+nyā na sid+dhi ho pad+māka ra dzā ha bīr mi tra dzo ki kang ka ni 'od gsal mchog dang dharma'i mtshan rtsa brgyud bla ma khyed rnams la lus ngag yid gsum gsol 'debs kyis bdag gi sgo gsum byin brlabs nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dang mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs srog thur ma bu yongs 'dres nas rtags bcu ngo mtshar brgyad la sogs brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin nas dag pa'i zhing khams bgrod par shog ces gsol ba snying khong rus pa'i gting nas btab bla ma 'od zhu rang gi dbu ma'i nang du thim snang ba thams cad 'ja' 'od bun ne ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag dngos gzhi dbu ma 'dzug skabs rang lus rdo rje phag mo sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan dmar 'od 'tsher ba phyi nang thams cad 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can stong sang sang ba yang phyod phyod pa bar snang khams na ye re yod pa phru ma phus btab pa lta bu'i spyi bor phag zhal mthing nag ngur ba lus nang du rtsa dbu ma rang gi lag ngar tsam phyi sngo nang dmar skya yar rtse spyi bo phag zhal gyi mgrin pa dang mar sna srin po'i sgor slebs pa mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa gsal btab nas dbu ma 'dzug bskor 'then gsum phra la mnyen pa ma byung gi bar thun drug tu sbyang dmigs skor dang po'o dmigs skor gnyis pa ni khu tshur pus steng bzhag nas ka ba 'dzugs dmigs pa srin po'i sgor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sen gang ba gcig gsal btab yar 'then dus rtsa mdud thams cad bkrol nas phag zhal gyi spyi bor skya thal gyis slebs 'jog dus rtsa mdud thams cad mar bkrol nas srin po'i sgor skya gsal gyis slebs de ma 'byongs bar du sbyang bar bya'o dmigs skor gsum pa ni dbu ma'i mar sna 'og sgor phag zhal dmar mo ngur sgra sgrog pa de'i nus pas 'byung ba sa chu me rlung nam mkha' sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal brtan g.yo snod bcud ma lus pa 'ub bsdus

spyi bo'i lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa 'bul dbu ma'i nang thams cad 'od zer gyis gang bar bsam dmigs skor bzhi pa ni 'og sgo'i phag zhal dmar mo'i yar snyan gyi nang du yi ge he ser po gser gyi mdog can gcig bsam ka ba 'dzugs pa'i tshe he ser po'i sna la 'byung ba sa bcud dang thig le gser btso ma ltar spyi bo'i phag zhal gyi mgrin par sleb lha tshogs mchod rtsa mdud thams cad grol a wa dhū ti'i rang bzhin du bsam mo dmigs skor lnga pa ni 'og sgo'i phag zhal nas rdo rje phag mo sor gang ba gcig yar dbu ma'i nang la zhugs gri gug gis rtsa mdud thams cad bkrol spyi bor rgyang 'thon rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med par gyur dmigs skor drug pa ni sdong po gsum bltab la mang du sbyang dmigs skor bdun pa ni srin po kha 'gyed la rtags ma thon bar du sbyang dmigs skor brgyad pa rlung 'tsho bcud 'tsho la sbyang de rnams la brtan pa thob pa dang thur ma 'dzugs pa gong du gsal rlung bshal rdzas bshal gang byed kyi dmigs pa phyag len tshul ma 'chug pa'i zhal las dris bcud 'tsho ba'i 'phrul 'khor se ke re'i lus gnad shin tu zab lus gnad bla ma'i zhal las shes rā hu la rak+ṣa si

ྈྈ 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'beb bzhugs so na mo gu ru dzā ha bīr ka dag blo 'das chos dbyings pho brang du sku gsum bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs phung po lhag med 'ja' lus 'grub pa dang tshe 'dir mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs 'pho med 'jigs bral bde chen pho brang du rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs phung po lhag med 'ja' lus 'grub pa dang tshe 'dir mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs snang srid 'od lnga tshom bu'i pho brang du rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs phung po lhag med 'ja' lus 'grub pa dang tshe 'dir mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs mi shigs rdo rje gsum ldan pho brang du drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs phung po lhag med 'ja' lus 'grub pa dang tshe 'dir mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs gnas lugs 'du 'bral med pa'i pho brang du mched dang lcam dral tshogs la gsol ba 'debs phung po lhag med 'ja' lus 'grub pa dang tshe 'dir mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs rim dgu sde bzhi man ngag kun gyi bcud zab chos 'od phung rang grol la gsol ba 'debs phung po lhag med 'ja' lus 'grub pa dang tshe 'dir mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang du gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi la gsol ba 'debs phung po lhag med 'ja' lus 'grub pa dang tshe 'dir mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol btab mthus 'khrul snang tshe 'di'i zhen pa chod pa dang zag bcas 'khor ba'i rkyen la ma ltos par zag med rlung gi bza' btung gos kyis 'tsho tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'khor ba dong sprugs shog ces pa'i gsol 'debs 'di nyid sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa' ི byang chub sems dpa'i gnas chen bde chen pad+ma gling phug gi ngo mtshar kun gzigs su chos rje grags pas bskul ngor gang thon du bris pa'o

ma dag 'khrul pa thams cad rang sar zhig bde chen ye shes mchog la mnga' dbang sgyur he ru ka dpal rigs brgya'i khyab bdag che rig 'dzin nyi zla klong gsal rgyal gyur cig ྈྈ 'ja' lus 'od phung rang grol las phrin las dag pa rab 'byams bzhugs sa ོ na mo gu ru dzā ha bīr ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'gro ba la gnyis med rang grol ston mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug dzā ha bīr mi 'bral snying gi thig ler bzhugs de mnyes mchod pa'i rim pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang bgegs gtor bsngo ba spyi dang mtshungs bka' bsgo ba ni hūm̐ hrī srid gsum zhing du 'khod pa'i sde brgyad dang ma rig 'khrul snang log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs lan chags gtor ma 'di yis tshims gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dengs shig hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+rī wa badz+ra bha rā hi 'byung po u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa dang hūm̐ bzhi ma brjod mtshams gcod cing srung 'khor bsgom pa ni hūm̐ hrī ye nas thams cad chos dbyings rang bzhin la snang srid snod bcud ma bcos gzhi yi lha rang babs lhun grub gnyug ma'i ngang du grol rang rig rang shar ngang du mtshams bcad do tsit+ta dharma badz+ra a a a a a skyabs sems ni hūm̐ hrī sdug bsngal las kyis mnar ba'i skye 'gro rnams zung 'jug 'ja' lus 'od sku ma thob bar bde gshegs rigs 'dus lha la skyabs su mchi gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i 'phrang las bsgral ba'i phyir 'khrul pa rang dag ngang du sems bskyed do zhes dang tshogs gsag sgrib sbyong gi skor ni thog mar yan lag bdun pa ni hūm̐ hrī ka dag ngang las lhun grub skur bzhengs pa'i rang rtsal rig pa rang shar lha tshogs rnams 'ja' 'od 'od phung thig le'i klong nas gshegs snang srid dag pa rab 'byams mchod par 'bul sgo gsum sdig sgrib nyams chag dag gyur cig zag med dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskul 'chi med rtag par bzhugs gsol dge ba'i mthus

'gro kun 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob shog sdom bzung ni rtsa gsum dam tshig sa ya 'bum sde rnams srog phyir mi spang bsgrub bo sa ma ya rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni rgyal ba kun 'dus rigs bdag rdo rje sems thugs srog skye med a yig rang sgra sgrog sngar bsags sgo gsum las rnams mthol lo bshags bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī dag pa rab 'byams 'od gsal tshom bu'i klong rtsa ba'i bla ma grub chen dzā ha bīr rgyal po'i rol stabs ḍā ru tshe bum 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma rgya mtsho'i dbus na bzhugs gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs 'pho med 'od lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs maṇ+ḍal na ི phyi nang snod bcud bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dang kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' khyab par 'bul dbang bzhi zhu ba ni lus ngag yid la sku gsung thugs mchog gi ye shes rnam lnga'i gzi byin bskyed du gsol kā ya wā ka tsit+ta ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ de nas dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni mchod rdzas byin rlabs dang byin 'beb na ི hūm̐ hrī skye med bhan+dha thod dkar yangs pa'i nang phyi nang gsang gsum rdzas mchog a mṛta gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ro nus ldan rigs lnga yab yum zung 'jug rab sbyar ba'i mnyam nyid dga' bzhi'i bde stong lhan cig skyes 'khor 'das rang grol mchod pa'i sprin phung 'khrigs gdod ma rang shar lha la mchod pa 'bul 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i byin chen phob ma hā gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar dang sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā zhes dang dngos gzhi ni hūm̐ hrī snang srid ye nas dag pa'i rang mdangs las ma bcos lhun grub chos 'byung me dpung klong rang rig hrīḥlas rta phag zhal phyag rdzogs de nyid dbu gtsug chos 'byung 'od lnga'i klong rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub chen dzā ha bīr sku mdog dkar dmar 'ja' zer 'od phung 'khrugs

phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas tshe bum 'dzin rin chen me tog sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras gsang ba'i yum mchog bde chen dz+nyā na 'khril g.yas g.yon nyi ma zla ba 'od phung 'bar rtsa brgyud bla ma rgya mtsho'i dbus na bzhugs de nyid dbu gtsug pad sdong 'od lnga'i klong rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun thod phreng rtsal sku mdog sngon po rdor dril bsnol thabs 'dzin pang du gsang ba'i yum mchog man+dhā ra gri thod rgyan can pad skyil yab la 'khril 'ja' zer 'od phung thig le'i klong na bzhugs bdag nyid rta phag yab yum gnas lnga ru dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor 'od phung 'thibs phyogs bzhir 'ja' 'od 'od phung thig le'i klong mkha' 'gro sde bzhi 'dzum mdangs gar nyams 'khyug stong gsal ma 'gags lhun grub ngang du bsgom spyan 'dren pa ni hūm̐ hrī chos dbyings bde chen dpal ri 'od gsal klong dag pa rab 'byams mkha' 'gro 'ja' sprin 'khrigs rang byung lhun grub pad 'byung yab yum dang zhi khro rab 'byams rtsa gsum dwangs ma'i lha gnas 'dir 'gro la dgongs te gshegs su gsol phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnas bcu dang nub phyogs o rgyan dag pa mkha' spyod zhing 'ja' 'od lnga ldan sku thig tshom bu'i klong 'ja' lus 'pho med 'jigs bral rdo rje'i sku rtsa brgyud bla ma grub chen dzā ha bīr gnas 'dir 'gro la dgongs te gshegs su gsol rang lus 'byung ba bzhi dag 'od gsal klong dwangs ma ye shes lnga ldan pho brang nas rang snang ḍā ki dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang grangs med 'bum phrag yangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams gnas 'dir 'gro la dgongs te gshegs su gsol tshom bu 'od lnga'i klong du bzhugs su gsol zung 'jug 'od phung ngang la phyag 'tshal lo blang dor 'dzin pa rang dag mchod pa 'bul 'khor gsum dmigs med ngang nas bzhes su gsol ma hā sarba pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐ mnyam yangs blo 'das ngang nas phyag 'tshal lo phyi nang gsang gsum dam rdzas sman rag dang
